job.description:
Scopely is looking for a Client Engineer to join an unannounced title based in our Shanghai office (5 days in the office).

 At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily. 

 We are in the early stages of development on an ambitious mobile game in China, and we’re assembling a team of passionate game makers to craft unforgettable characters and immersive adventures that players will love.

 What You Will Do

 We are looking for a Client Engineer to help build the next generation of our games. You will work with a team of passionate engineers while developing core systems and features that power large-scale, real-time experiences for our unannounced game title. You’ll work on complex technical challenges involving real-time interaction, large-scale systems, and a persistent shared world used by tens of millions of players.

- Develop, and maintain key client-side components that enable rich, scalable game experiences.

- Partner closely with server, product, design, and other cross-functional teams to ensure technical alignment and product quality.

- Apply engineering best practices, including code reviews, unit testing, load testing, and performance optimization.

- Troubleshoot complex issues across mobile platforms to ensure stability and uptime for live systems.

- Participate in regular in-person meetings and collaboration sessions (role requires 5 days/week in office).

 What We're Looking For

- Experience developing commercial games in Unity, C#

- Experience with at least one of the following: 

- Mobile native coding (Java/Kotlin for Android, ObjC/Swift for iOS, C/C++ for native)

- Network programming, cloud computing and server debugging

- Graphics programming for 3D games

- Familiar with Git, Bash and Gradle

- Strong problem solving and communication skills

- Professional proficiency in both Mandarin and English

- BS / MS in Computer Science or Software Engineering or equivalent

 Bonus Points 

- Experience with profiling and optimization for mobile

- Experience with developing productivity tools and creating efficient procedures

- Rich experience in playing mobile games and console games

- Experience leading a team: task breakdown&scoping, code reviews, mentoring junior devs, prototyping, etc.

- Excellent verbal English communication

 At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us & embrace the adventure!

 About Scopely

 Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

 Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

 Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

 Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/ . 

 Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official website and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @ scopely.com .

 Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice .

Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.

 We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.

 That's where you come in.

 About the Role 

 As a Senior Technical Artist, Rendering on the Unpublished R&D Product team, you will translate creative direction into scalable, performant real-time rendering solutions. You will work across materials, shaders, lighting, and rendering systems in Unreal Engine 5 (UE5), partnering with engineering, art, and design teams to address visual and technical challenges. You will help improve rendering workflows, establish technical standards, and support consistent visual quality across hardware platforms.

 You will report into the Tech Lead of the team.

 Responsibilities: 

- 
 Develop and implement rendering solutions that support visual direction and maintain consistency across platforms.

- 
 Create, maintain, and optimize UE5 materials, shaders, and related rendering content.

- 
 Partner with rendering engineers, artists, and designers to deliver rendering solutions within established performance budgets.

- 
 Define rendering scalability settings, quality tiers, and fallback strategies for different hardware configurations.

- 
 Profile and optimize shader performance, GPU workloads, memory utilization, and asset loading.

- 
 Improve rendering workflows, technical standards, production tools, and documentation to support efficient content creation.

- Provide technical guidance to artists, resolve complex rendering challenges, and promote consistent rendering practices across the team.

 Qualifications:

- 
 5+ years of professional experience in technical art, real-time graphics, or related game development disciplines, including 4+ years working with Unreal Engine.

- 
 Experience contributing rendering or technical art solutions to a shipped or long-running production project.

- 
 Proficiency with UE5 material systems, shaders, and real-time rendering workflows, including the ability to read and write HLSL.

- 
 Strong understanding of real-time rendering principles, lighting, material behavior, and content production workflows.

- 
 Experience translating visual direction into technical rendering implementations involving materials, lighting, post-processing, or visual composition.

- 
 Experience using profiling and performance analysis tools to identify and resolve GPU, shader, memory, and rendering performance issues across hardware configurations.

- 
 Experience documenting technical solutions and collaborating with artists and engineers to balance visual quality, performance, and maintainability.

 Preferred Qualifications:

- 
 Experience adapting rendering solutions across multiple platforms, including quality tiers, feature fallbacks, and performance optimization strategies.

- 
 Experience developing stylized rendering solutions or rendering systems for characters, environments, visual effects, vegetation, or related visual content.

- 
 Experience establishing asset standards, rendering guidelines, technical documentation, or performance budget frameworks.

- 
 Experience implementing and optimizing advanced UE5 rendering features, including Lumen, Nanite, and Virtual Shadow Maps.

 For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!

- Profile and optimize effects for visual quality, gameplay clarity, memory, and runtime performance, helping establish practical budgets for high effect density and resource-constrained scenarios.

 Required Qualifications: 

- Senior-level professional experience as a Technical Artist, VFX Technical Artist, or closely related role in games or real-time content production.

- Advanced hands-on Unreal Engine experience, including Niagara systems, Niagara modules and Scratchpad, Blueprint, and material authoring or Material Graphs.

- Strong scripting and automation skills for artist-facing tools and content workflows, with the ability to work productively in Python, Blueprint, or comparable scripting environments.

- Hands-on pipeline development experience, including procedural workflows, asset generation, and integration with real-time content pipelines.

- Proven experience designing or maintaining reusable, modular, and parameterized VFX systems, libraries, or production workflows.

- Strong understanding of real-time VFX readability, profiling, optimization, and performance budgeting, with the ability to balance visual quality and runtime constraints.

- Demonstrated ability to collaborate across Art, Design, and Engineering, communicate technical trade-offs clearly, and support artists through tool iteration and problem-solving.

 Desired Qualifications:

- Experience supporting large-scale multiplayer or live-service content pipelines, where consistency, scalability, and maintainability are central production concerns.

- Experience developing procedural content workflows or reusable generation systems in Houdini, Unreal, or related tools.

- Experience with streaming, resource, memory, or workload optimization for content-rich real-time experiences.

- Familiarity with shader or engine-level development, including HLSL, C++, or comparable low-level graphics and runtime technologies.

- A portfolio or reel that demonstrates technical breakdowns, reusable systems, artist-facing tools, pipeline improvements, and the impact of your work on content production.

 For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players.  At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

 Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

 ENGINEERING - GAMES

 What We Do 

 Unreal projects have been leading the pack of real-time entertainment with our constantly growing team of engineering experts. We’re always improving on the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

 What You'll Do 

 We are seeking an experienced Lead Gameplay Programmer to direct gameplay teams within Rocket League. They will be responsible for leading the gameplay programming team and collaborating and iterating with gameplay programmers, game designers, producers, and artists. They will play a critical role in feature development for Rocket League.

 In this role, you will 

- Manage a team of seasoned gameplay programmers and be the primary hub of communication and information for other disciplines

- Distill high-level feature requests into meaningful, actionable work items and delegate effectively to the team

- Deliver core gameplay features efficiently and on time, and speak up when the team is over- or under-scoped

- Lead the vision for different gameplay systems and features and write code and do system design as needed

- Propose and review technical design, systems, and technical approaches to ensure that they satisfy requirements and promote a healthy codebase

- Work closely with art and design leads to ensure gameplay mechanics meet functional requirements and uphold our high standards

- Work closely with other programming disciplines to integrate systems in support of the player experience

 What we're looking for 

- Experience developing gameplay physics systems (simulation, collision, character/vehicle physics, etc.)

- Experience with network replication systems (client-server prediction, state synchronization, lag compensation)

- Proven track record delivering live-service games or AAA MMO titles built on Unreal Engine

- Proven leadership experience managing high-performing programming teams on shipped AAA titles

- Strong C++ skills and the ability to code and design gameplay mechanics and tools

- Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills, as well as the ability to collaborate and communicate to work cross-functionally and give/receive constructive feedback

- Experience using AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code) to improve development efficiency and streamline programming workflows

 EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

 We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.
 ABOUT US

 Epic Games​ ​is a leading interactive entertainment company. For over 30 years we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

 Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic! 

 Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

 Note to Recruitment Agencies: Epic does not accept any unsolicited resumes or approaches from any unauthorized third party (including recruitment or placement agencies) (i.e., a third party with whom we do not have a negotiated and validly executed agreement). We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here .

 What You'll Do 

 We're looking for a Lead Technical Artist to guide a team of Technical Artists in building visually compelling, performant game worlds as part of our collaboration with Disney. Working closely with Art, Engineering, and Design, you'll translate project goals into practical tools, workflows, and technical solutions. This is a hands-on leadership role focused on day-to-day execution, team mentorship, and solving production challenges. You'll help deliver the studio's technical art direction.

 In this role, you will 

- Profile game content and resolve performance bottlenecks in collaboration with Art and Engineering

- Optimize geometry, materials, shaders, textures, lighting, foliage, and VFX to meet established performance and memory budgets 

- Help artists apply best practices for LODS, instancing, streaming, and content scalability across target platforms 

- Conduct content reviews and develop validation tools to identify technical issues early 

- Develop and maintain tools that support efficient environment creation, including terrain, foliage, procedural generation, and asset placement 

- Partner with Environment Art and Level Design to improve world-building workflows and troubleshoot production issues 

- Implement established standards for modular assets, materials, and content organization 

- Document tools and workflows, helping artists adopt them effectively 

- Lead the day-to-day work of a small Technical Art team, coordinating priorities and deliverables with Production and technical leadership 

- Mentor Technical Artists through feedback, technical reviews, and hands-on problem-solving 

- Balance individual contributions with delegation, giving team members clear ownership and opportunities to grow 

- Communicate progress, dependencies, and technical risks to project leadership 

- Coordinate Initiatives with Tech Art Leads on other projects working in the same development environment 

- Help establish practical usage guidelines and train artists on approved workflows, following studio policies for intellectual property, licensing, and data security 

- Evaluate results against quality and efficiency goals, recommending which workflows to refine or expand 

 What we're looking for 

- Experience shipping and supporting a live-service game 

- Strong professional experience in technical art for games, including contributions to a shipped title or comparably complex production 

- Experience leading or mentoring Technical Artists and coordinating technical work across disciplines 

- Practical knowledge of real-time rendering, profiling, content optimization, and performance budgets 

- Experience with world-building pipelines, procedural workflows, LOD systems, and content streaming 

- Proficiency with Unreal Engine, Unity, or a proprietary game engine 

- Scripting or programming experience for tool development, using languages such as Python, C#, or C++ 

- Familiarity with shader and material development, alongside tools such as Houdini, Maya, or Blender 

- Strong problem-solving, communication, and prioritization skills, with an appreciation for artistic quality 

 EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

drafts.body:
Hello Epic Games Hiring Team,

I'm applying for the Lead Technical Artist role at Epic Games. I'm a Senior Unity 3D Developer with 10 years of experience; I have built mobile games and applications for Android and iOS and worked with seven studios in Ahmedabad, building gameplay, UI, integrations and complete games from idea to launch. I currently work at Phibonacci Solution, Ahmedabad.

What I would bring to this role:
- Unity 3D (incl. Unity 6) and C#: clean, reusable production code across seven studios, from idea to launch
- Graphics: URP, Shader Graph, materials and lighting
- Performance: Unity Profiler, memory optimization, object pooling and draw-call optimization
- Unity Editor tooling: editor extensions, custom inspectors and automation that help teams ship faster

I'm based in India and open to relocating to Cary for this role.

Portfolio: https://denishmakadiya-unity.github.io/
GitHub: https://github.com/denishmakadiya-unity
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/denish-makadiya-a0b776ab

My resume is attached. I'd welcome a short conversation about how I can help.

job.description:
WE ARE GAME MAKERS 

 Who We Are: 

 We are a diverse team of developers driven by a passion for our art, united by our core values and inspired by a culture of inclusivity to build amazing games that thrill players everywhere. We pursue growth and innovation in an environment of safety and trust. Our culture is built on the belief that the more varied voices in our collective will strengthen our team and our games. We are looking for our next teammate who will raise our bar and make us better.

 What We Need: 

 We’re seeking a Senior Shader Technical Artist to leverage their technical skills and artistic understanding to help develop and maintain a strong shader pipeline that will serve teams across multiple disciplines. Your passion, knowledge, and experience will be integral to the look and style of a new generation of player-driven experiences, stemming from your ability to create high-quality shaders and technology that bring life to the worlds we build.

 What You'll Do: 

- Utilize extensive experience in Unreal Engine to meticulously craft and optimize shader/master materials using Unreal Engine’s node-based shader graph and HLSL/GLSL/CG shader code, ensuring they are built cleanly and efficiently for seamless integration and user-friendly utilization by the materials team.

- Collaborate with development teams to establish and uphold artistic and technical shader standards, pushing the boundaries of real-time rendering while adhering to performance constraints.

- Drive the development of innovative approaches to address complex technical and creative challenges, participating in the creation of shaders, shading validation tools, and defining shading standards.

- Provide technical support in identifying and resolving inefficient content pipelines, conducting performance profiling, and optimizing shaders to enhance overall visual fidelity and maintain desired frame rates.

- Demonstrate a strong sense of ownership and autonomy in task execution, producing high-quality work with minimal oversight, and actively seeking opportunities to enhance pipeline efficiency and visual quality.

- Create documentation, examples, and reusable best practices for distributed development teams, establishing and maintaining practical standards for assets, materials, textures, meshes, LODs, collision, naming, and project organization.

- Work with Art, Engineering, Design, Animation, Lighting, and other disciplines to solve cross-discipline production problems.

- Evaluate workflows and identify technical risks or production bottlenecks before they become larger problems.

 What Will Make You a Great Fit: 

- 7+ years of experience or at least one shipped title in a Technical Art role, with proficiency in creating stylized and PBR shaders using node-based shader editors, tiled layered material systems, shader networks, procedural texturing, and HLSL code.

- Strong understanding of the technical foundations behind visually stunning textures and shaders in a physically-based rendering pipeline.

- Ability to communicate and collaborate across disciplines, sharing ideas and articulating visions.

- Familiarity with all the tools, techniques, and asset creation pipelines: UE5, Substance Designer, Substance Painter, Photoshop, modeling, baking, and texturing.

 Bonus: 

- Experience in Unreal Engine’s node-based shader graph.

- Strong understanding of console, PC, and mobile platforms, and how to scale shaders to optimize for each.

 The pay range for this position in California at the start of employment is expected to be between $112,700 and $164,860 per Year. However, base pay offered is based on market location, and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations. 

Subject to those same considerations, the total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a bonus and/or equity awards and eligibility to participate in our 401(K) plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program.

Regular, full-time employees are also eligible for a range of benefi ts at the Company, including: medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance coverage; 14 paid holidays per calendar year; paid vacation time per calendar year (ranging from 15 to 25 days) or eligibility to participate in the Company’s discretionary time off program; up to 10 paid sick days per calendar year; paid parental and compassionate leave; wellbeing programs for mental health and other wellness support; family planning support through Maven; commuter benefi ts; and reimbursements for fi tness-related expenses. Ontario only: The use of Artifi cial Intelligence is not being used to screen candidates. The position is for an existing vacancy.

 #LI-Onsite
#LI-Hybrid

job.description:
Our Mission: 

 To capture the hearts and minds of millions of players across the world by creating unforgettable games powered by the best technology.

 About Us: 

 PlayQ is a rapidly growing entertainment and technology company that recognizes quality is king as we deliver unforgettable mobile game experiences to a global audience. Our games engage millions of users daily, surprising them with creativity, beauty and fun!

 Our portfolio includes hit titles like Treasure Party , which combines match-3 puzzle gameplay with a board game adventure for a vibrant treasure-hunting experience, and Sort Wizard , a fresh take on sorting puzzle mechanics that challenges and delights players. Both games are quickly building strong followings in their genres, offering fun, rewarding journeys for puzzle lovers and adventurers alike.

 Our team is driven, playful and deeply committed to excellence and innovation. We work together to craft clever, visually stunning, and memorable experiences. PlayQ's environment values initiative, collaboration, and individual leadership to ensure that our mission is fulfilled.

 Who You Are: 

- Proactive Achiever You consistently take the initiative to drive business results, supported by sound reasoning and detailed execution plans.

- Growth Driver You champion company-wide success by relentlessly focusing on achieving results, understanding how your work impacts the entire organization, and pushing to make it 10% better every time. You continuously level yourself up and drive the business forward.

- Solution Seeker Fueled by curiosity, you explore various ways to solve a problem. Every hard problem is an opportunity in disguise. 

- Team Builder You actively foster strong dynamics within and between teams, contributing to our collective success.

- Resilient Leader You consistently approach your work with resilience and a steadfast passion for achievement of our goals despite challenges or setbacks.

- Data-Driven Creator You leverage data to back intuition. Empirical creativity is your go-to. Imagination led, data validated.

 Why you'll want to come to work: 

 Our Senior Motion Graphics Designer role offers the opportunity to directly shape PlayQ’s growth through high-quality, performance driven user acquisition creative.

 This is a hands-on individual contributor role focused on creating motion graphics, editorial content, gameplay driven ads, and high volume creative iterations for paid media campaigns. You will work closely with Marketing Art and User Acquisition to turn creative direction and performance learnings into engaging short form ads.

 Your work will contribute directly to PlayQ’s growth by creating strong hooks, clear gameplay stories, and modular creative assets that can be tested, optimized, resized, and scaled efficiently across advertising platforms.

 Your Responsibilities: 

- Motion Design: Design and animate high-quality motion graphics for user acquisition, social, and digital marketing campaigns using typography, transitions, visual effects, gameplay assets, UI, and graphic design to create visually compelling advertising creatives.

- Video Production: Edit gameplay capture, promotional footage, AI-generated content, voiceover, music, and sound effects into engaging short-form video ads that effectively communicate gameplay, features, rewards, and player motivations.

- Creative Storytelling: Apply strong editorial principles including pacing, timing, rhythm, and visual storytelling to create compelling narratives, impactful opening hooks, and high-performing marketing creatives.

- Creative Development: Produce both net-new creative concepts and high-volume iterations of existing ads, developing structured variations that test hooks, messaging, gameplay moments, pacing, visual treatments, ensuring that all creative decisions improve campaign performance

- Performance Marketing: Create performance-driven video ads for major paid media platforms including Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube, AppLovin, Moloco, and other digital advertising channels, leveraging user acquisition best practices and platform-specific requirements.

- Production Efficiency: Build organized, modular After Effects projects and reusable creative templates that enable rapid iteration, efficient production workflows, and consistent creative quality across campaigns.

- Creative Optimization: Adapt marketing assets into polished deliverables across multiple aspect ratios, formats, and advertising placements while maintaining visual consistency and production excellence.

- Project Organization: Maintain well-structured project files, naming conventions, source assets, and deliverables to support scalable creative production and effective cross-functional collaboration.

- AI-Enhanced Production: Leverage modern AI tools to accelerate ideation, content generation, editing, iteration, and creative adaptation while applying strong creative judgment to ensure quality, consistency, and brand alignment.

- Industry Research: Stay current on mobile advertising trends, emerging creative technologies, social media formats, competitor creatives, and evolving user acquisition best practices to continuously improve creative effectiveness.

- Collaboration: Partner closely with Creative Director, User Acquisition, Design, and cross-functional stakeholders to align on campaign objectives, share creative insights, and deliver high-performing marketing assets.

 What you’ll bring to the team: 

- Experience: 5+ years of professional experience in motion graphics, video editing, digital advertising, or performance marketing creative, with experience producing user acquisition creatives for mobile games.

- Portfolio: A strong portfolio demonstrating expertise in motion design, editorial storytelling, gameplay advertising, and short-form video production that showcases measurable creative quality and performance.

- Expertise: Advanced proficiency in Adobe After Effects, strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, Adobe Photoshop, and working knowledge of Adobe Illustrator, with the ability to execute polished motion graphics and video editing workflows.

- Creative Skills: Deep understanding of animation principles, typography, composition, visual hierarchy, compositing, pacing, rhythm, storytelling, music editing, sound design, and audio synchronization as applied to performance marketing.

- Production Ability: Proven ability to combine gameplay footage, UI elements, typography, visual effects, sound, and graphic design into engaging, performance-focused short-form advertising creatives.

- Optimization Mindset: Experience creating both original concepts and high-volume creative iterations, with a strong understanding of user acquisition testing methodologies, hook strategies, performance marketing workflows, and creative optimization.

- Technical Organization: Experience building organized, modular project files and reusable templates that support efficient production, rapid creative iteration, and scalable content development.

- Platform Knowledge: Familiarity with paid media platforms including Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube, AppLovin, Moloco, and other digital advertising ecosystems, along with an understanding of performance metrics such as CTR, CPI, ROAS, conversion, retention, and hook performance.

- AI Proficiency: Experience integrating AI tools into modern creative production workflows, including platforms such as Adobe Firefly, Photoshop AI, ChatGPT, Claude, and other emerging AI technologies to enhance ideation, editing, production, and creative adaptation while maintaining high creative standards.

- Collaboration: Excellent communication, organization, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to independently own creative projects from concept through final delivery.

 Bonus Points: 

- Industry Experience: Experience creating user acquisition creative for match-3, puzzle, casual, or hybrid casual mobile games, with a strong understanding of mobile gaming audiences and advertising strategies.

- Additional Creative Expertise: Experience producing App Store screenshots, promotional graphics, App Store Optimization (ASO) assets, or other marketing collateral supporting mobile game launches and growth.

- Technical Skills: Familiarity with Unity or other gameplay capture tools, Cinema 4D, Blender, or other 3D software for asset preparation and compositing support, as well as motion graphics plugins such as Trapcode, Saber, Element 3D, or similar technologies.

- AI & Emerging Technology: Experience using generative AI platforms such as Runway, Midjourney, and other advanced creative tools to support content production and innovation.

- Performance Collaboration: Experience working directly with User Acquisition teams and applying campaign performance insights, creative testing results, and user behavior data to continuously improve future creative development.

 Working at PlayQ: 

- Remote Work Environment . Work remotely from anywhere, with the flexibility to structure your day around your location while collaborating closely with our HQ and global teams.

- Meaningful ownership & impact. Take ownership of growth initiatives and directly influence the strategy, performance, and success of our games.

- AI-powered tools . Access to company-provided AI tools and paid subscriptions to support creative work, experimentation, and productivity.

- Flexible time off. Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy balance while delivering against your goals.

- Career growth & visibility . Work closely with senior leadership and have the opportunity to grow your scope and influence as the business and products scale.

- Create incredible games—for a living! Because who doesn’t love games? 

 At PlayQ, we leverage competitive benchmarking data when setting each role’s base pay range. Individual base salary will be determined based on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, scope of role, business need and geographic location.

 If your skillset aligns with the requirements of this role, we will contact you through our official Applicant Tracking System (Greenhouse) or company email address (@playq.net). If you receive communication from a different domain, this communication is not from a legitimate representative of PlayQ.

- Personally design, validate, and implement core solutions for aiming and weapon handling experience, procedural animation, animation graphs, and state orchestration. Identify and resolve animation quality issues across assets, engine, gameplay, and runtime from both first-person and third-person perspectives.

- Hold decision-making authority for the project’s animation technical approach. Establish animation technical specifications, review standards, problem-diagnosis methods, and effect acceptance mechanisms. Drive stable mass production and continuous iteration of solutions within the project.

- Collaborate with animation, programming, and game design teams to translate animation technical solutions into executable development plans and advance cross-team implementation.

- Lead and mentor the animation TA team through matrix management, with authority to set team technical standards. Responsible for technical direction, coaching on complex issues, capability building, and experience accumulation, while enhancing the team’s ability to independently tackle difficult problems with project delivery as a priority.

 Job Requirements 

- Many years of experience in game animation and animation TA R&D, having worked on top-tier high-quality realistic PvP shooter products. Experience in runtime animation development for Call of Duty PvP or equivalent-level shooting projects is preferred.

- Deep understanding of the feel and runtime performance of dual-perspective shooting games. Ability to independently take ownership of the design, R&D, and closed-loop delivery of one or more core systems, such as aiming and weapon handling, procedural animation, animation graphs, and state orchestration.

- Complete game development pipeline experience. Ability to independently drive targeted quality breakthroughs in runtime animation — from problem identification and technical validation to cross-team execution and live-operation effect evaluation.

- Matrix-style technical leadership capability. Ability to set animation technical standards, break down R&D tasks, guide animation TAs’ professional growth, and lead the existing team to upgrade capabilities while prioritizing project delivery.

- Not limited to a single engine. Familiar with the runtime animation architecture of at least one mainstream or proprietary engine, and able to solve animation R&D problems using DCC tools, scripting, and toolchains. Experience with multiple engines is preferred.

- Experience in high-quality action game development, international project collaboration, or the ability to balance quality, performance, and maintainability in multi-character, multi-state, high-concurrency multiplayer scenarios is preferred.

- Ability to use AI/Agents for animation data processing, R&D assistance, tool automation, problem analysis, or workflow efficiency improvements is preferred.

job.description:
Insomniac is looking for a new Lead Systems Designer. This role is accountable for the quality and on-time delivery of all design systems for a large-scale game production, as well as the direct management, mentorship, and growth of a small Systems Design team. Duties will be split between management and hands-on design as needed.

 The ideal candidates are self-driven, focused on practical, high-quality execution, and will strive to create an environment in continuous improvement – both on screen and our staff.

 Essential Duties and Responsibilities 

- Responsible for managing, mentoring, and directing a team of Systems Designers, including regular coaching, career development, and performance management. Serves as hiring manager for Systems Designers.

- Oversees and directly works on the design, prototyping, iteration and polish of gameplay systems such as player mechanics, non-combat systems, world simulation, economy, progression, or game balance. May lead one or more development pods of cross-discipline contributors.

- Directly prototypes, implements, and iterates on gameplay systems through proprietary internal tools and scripting systems.

- Fosters a strong environment of creative collaboration across all disciplines. Works directly with Gameplay Programming counterparts to best leverage skills and creativity across both departments for systems design and implementation.

- Writes and regularly updates clear gameplay system documentation detailing the scope and feature set for gameplay features. Creates tutorial videos and documentation to support systems.

- Works with Project Management to plan and maintain the systems design schedule, set priorities, plan milestones, and assign work to Systems Designers. Proactively communicates across the team to create alignment among stakeholders and clarity about status, direction, and dependencies. 

- Regularly reviews design work in progress, proactively gathers feedback, and drives iteration and quality. Accountable for creative quality of all game design systems work and for ensuring the team is hitting on-screen quality targets for each milestone.

- Collaborates with the Design Director and project Game Director to ensure systems design meets the project’s creative and technical goals.

- Ensures consistency in design systems across the whole game experience by creating, tracking, and enforcing standards and metrics. Directly supports Mission Design work in this as needed.

- Runs brainstorms / reviews, creates buy-in and alignment, and champions design vision and values through clear communication and inclusivity.

- Works with other Systems Design staff across the studio to develop best practices, shared process, and design standards.

- Creates a safe, supportive, and creative work environment that exemplifies our studio values.

- Other managerial and creative duties as needed.

 Supervisory Duties 

 Directly supervises a team of Systems Designers. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; resolving problems together with the Team and Design Department leadership.

 Computer Skills:  

- Intermediate knowledge and experience with level editing tools and scripting (Unreal Engine, Unity, or similar editors). 

- Intermediate knowledge of Maya or other major 3D modeling programs. 

- Adobe Illustrator experience and UE4 Blueprint scripting skills are a plus. 

- Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite. 

 Other Skills: 

-  Individual must have very good interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate effectively with team members and other developers. 

- Strong communication skills including verbal and written skills are required. 

- 
 Bachelors degree or equivalent

 At SIE, we consider several factors when setting each role’s base pay range, including the competitive benchmarking data for the market and geographic location. 

 Please note that the base pay range may vary in line with our hybrid working policy and individual base pay will be determined based on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. 

 In addition, this role is eligible for SIE’s top-tier benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, matching 401(k), paid time off, wellness program and coveted employee discounts for Sony products. This role also may be eligible for a bonus package. Click here to learn more. 

 This is a flexible role that can be remote, with varying pay ranges based on geographic location. For example, if you are based out of Seattle, the estimated base pay range for this role is listed below.
 $153,000 - $195,000 USD 

 Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.

ABOUT VOODOO

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

This position can be fully remote within CET +/-2h.



TEAM

Our Gaming team is made up of hybrid-casual, casual, and mid-core experts. Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing, and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games.

Joining our Live games team means collaborating with gaming industry experts on globally renowned, enduring games while embracing exciting new entrepreneurial ventures. With over seven billion downloads worldwide and a portfolio of more than 10 resilient hybrid games generating more than $20m per year, we are the world's largest and most successful hybrid publisher.

You will be joining one of our Live Studios, working on Paper.io 2 https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.voodoo.paper2&hl=en_US.

With Paper.io 2, we’re building an iconic game that players will never forget!

We're a small team of excellent people who take care of everything from ideas to testing, and we intend to grow while maintaining our high standards.




ROLE

We are looking for a talented Senior Game Developer with a good understanding of the casual mobile game market to help the team deliver fun, innovative, and entertaining features. You will take an innovative approach to gameplay ideas/features and give them their own spin.

 - Responsibilities will align with your strengths

 - Develop client-facing features, with a focus on UI, Animations & polish

 - Work on core gameplay improvements

 - Develop new meta features

 - Enhance and refine existing systems

With this role, you will have a strong impact on the company by contributing daily to important decisions with a senior, multidisciplinary team of passionate and talented people.  Flesh out the details of a game's design, oversee its testing, and revise the game in response to player feedback. Thanks to your creativity and your teamwork, let’s entertain millions of people with your hit games.




PROFILE

 - 5+ years of professional experience in C# and Unity

 - Proven track record in successful mobile game development

 - Exceptional expertise in a specialized area (e.g., animation, particle systems, shaders, architecture, performance optimization or networking) is a major plus

 - Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on optimization and performance

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

 - A creative, hands-on developer with a passion for quality work

 - AI-first mindset: Comfortable using AI daily and building custom agents or reusable automations to speed up your work




BENEFITS

 - Best-in-class compensation

 - Other benefits according to the country you reside

job.description:
ABOUT VOODOO

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.




TEAM

Our Gaming team is made up of hybrid-casual, casual and mid-core experts. Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games.



You'll join the Portfolio Games Team (PGT) within Live: a small, tech-first and AI-first team that manages and grows a catalogue of 40+ live mobile games played by millions of users worldwide, with many more titles being onboarded. We own the full lifecycle, from game health monitoring and A/B testing to ASO, release management and live operations. 



To do this at portfolio scale we are building Sophia, our in-house AI agent that already manages games, runs A/B tests and automates store work across dozens of games. Our goal is simple: take humans out of the repetitive loop so the team can focus on making the product better.





ROLE

We are looking for a freelance Technical Artist to bridge art and engineering in an AI-first studio. Our development side already moves fast with Sophia; art production is now the bottleneck. Your mission is to set up the conventions, tools and pipelines that let AI generate, check and integrate 2D and 3D assets across our portfolio with minimal human intervention. By Q1 2027 we want Sophia running full art and 3D flows end to end, and you will be key to getting there.



You will work day to day with our dev lead and the engineer who owns our AI/Figma/Unity art workflows, and with the art team.

 - Define art conventions and standards (naming, structure, layout rules for UI, banners and store assets) so that assets can be produced and validated automatically, not hand-polished one by one

 - Build tools and scripts in art software (Maya, plus Photoshop/Illustrator where useful) that check and fix assets automatically, e.g. validating that 3D meshes are watertight, within poly budgets and correctly set up, so an AI agent can run them as part of a pipeline

 - Optimise 3D models and meshes (topology, polygon count, UVs, LODs) and textures (compression, sizes, atlases) for mobile, without sacrificing visual quality

 - Own the Unity import pipeline: import settings, asset post-processors and automation so assets land in our games correctly and consistently

 - Integrate AI generation tools (image, 3D, animation) into production workflows and evaluate new ones as they appear

 - Help scale animated assets (e.g. animated store banners and promo visuals) across many games through templates and automation rather than manual work

 - Debug and fix graphical and performance issues across mobile devices; support shaders, VFX and particles where needed

 - Document everything so the pipelines keep running and improving after setup




PROFILE

 - 5+ years as a Technical Artist, ideally in mobile games

 - Hands-on experience using AI in art production (e.g. Scenario, Flux, 3D generation tools, ComfyUI or similar), and a mindset of automating rather than perfecting by hand

 - Strong understanding of 3D models and meshes and how to optimise them; you don't need to be a 3D modeller, but you know what makes a mesh production-ready

 - Strong Unity skills: asset import and optimisation, C# scripting for editor tools; Shader Graph/HLSL, VFX and particles are a plus

 - Experience building tooling for art software, in particular Maya (Python and/or MEL)

 - Solid grounding in Photoshop and Illustrator: the "art" in technical art matters to us

 - Good understanding of mobile constraints (performance, memory, draw calls, batching)

 - Autonomous, pragmatic and deadline-driven: you know when an asset is good enough and move on

 - Fluent written and spoken English




NICE TO HAVE

 - Python scripting outside art tools (pipelines, batch processing, APIs)

 - Experience with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) and LLM-based agents

 - Figma, and experience with UI/store assets for mobile games (ASO)

 - Substance or similar texturing tools; GPU profiling

job.description:
[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/fe16aa2c-8036-4689-bdb8-5b38c86affdf/royale%20pekka%20pancakes.jpeg]




We’re looking for a Game Designer to join one of our most exciting games, Clash Royale, and help shape it into an even bigger hit! We’re looking for someone who’s unafraid to aim beyond what’s been seen before, and can follow that up with execution. Your main responsibility on the team will be to develop and improve gameplay features, such as new cards and game modes. Design is a collective effort at Supercell, so it’s paramount that you’re a strong team player as well!

We offer you a chance to join a team of professionals where talent feeds talent. We do not believe in bureaucracy or convoluted processes. We believe game development is a team sport and work together to achieve the best results. We trust each other’s skills and value each other’s work. All of us are driven by the amazing opportunity to make a game played by tens of millions of players better and better. Excited? Read on!



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/7a053edc-bf2e-4db4-85ee-5630e2b5d305/banner_narrow_customs.jpg]




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 - Develop new characters, spells, troops, and forms that grow the game’s strategic depth and diversity of playstyles

 - Provide multiple potential designs and solutions, articulate trade-offs and risks between different options

 - Balance existing gameplay elements to ensure healthy engagement KPIs, and maintain a healthy state of the overall game meta

 - Contribute new design ideas and participate in feature development

 - Work closely with the rest of the team to ensure that new gameplay supports the overall game vision and roadmapWhat You Have


WHAT YOU HAVE

 - Extensive understanding, skills and experience with gameplay design

 - Track record with comparable games in action, strategy or RPG genres

 - Understanding of other design areas is a big plus

 - Excellent communication, interpersonal and organizational skills

 - Absolute passion for playing and making great games


WOULD BE NICE IF YOU ALSO HAVE

 - Dedicated Clash Royale player

 - Experience working on live games

 - Experience working in MOBA, RTS, or fighting genre




WHERE YOU'LL BE

This role will be based in our Helsinki office and yes we help with relocation! 

–––

That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read. 

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page. 

–––



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/88b3477a-7124-479e-babc-94125c5b23be/banner_narrow_allstars.jpg]


ABOUT SUPERCELL 

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices https://supr.cl/jd-offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games https://supr.cl/jd-games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings https://supercell.com/en/news/learning-from-failures/, and killing lots of projects. 



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/0272a5b3-a7a2-4f1c-b97b-725eae66daf0/banner_narrow_people3.jpg]


HEY, YOU MIGHT LOVE IT HERE!

Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture https://supr.cl/jd-why-you. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/49ae2117-cfbb-4fbd-bc4c-f67357d2f376/banner_narrow_titles.jpg]


YOU ARE NOT YOUR JOB TITLE ™

Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles https://supr.cl/jd-job-title or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/860d5de4-aa96-4e01-879c-889b7039330b/banner_narrow_chest.jpg]


BENEFITS AND COMPENSATION 

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits https://supr.cl/jd-benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/b52ac2fb-3f94-46bc-9c36-32ad780b2eae/banner_narrow_relocating.jpg]


RELOCATION? YES!

No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/f2248327-2504-48f3-8bf7-01a7dcd3296f/banner_narrow_portraits-2026%20(1).jpg]


NOT SURE IF YOU SHOULD APPLY? 

Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.

Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

job.description:
[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/514dfb89-54b4-4bf3-afe0-ceaf4ae3147e/our%20mission%20board.png]


Great-looking games don't happen because someone drew something beautiful. They happen because someone figured out how to get that beautiful thing running at a stable framerate, on a phone, in a build the whole team can iterate on twenty times a day. That someone is you.

We're looking for a Technical Artist to own the space between art and engineering on one of our new projects in the Shanghai studio. You'll be the person artists come to when the thing in Substance doesn't look like the thing in the engine, and the person programmers come to when the frame budget is blown and nobody's sure whose fault it is. You'll shape the visual identity of the game as much as any artist does — just through shaders, tooling, and pipelines rather than pixels.

This is a small team with a lot of ownership. Nobody will hand you a spec.

If that sounds like your kind of problem, we'd love to hear from you！

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/66a7198f-9ccd-4ba2-ac72-488ce331f438/banner_narrow_customs.jpg]




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 - Own the shader and material library. Author the shaders that give the game its look, design a master-material architecture artists can actually work with, and keep permutation counts and shader complexity from quietly eating the frame

 - Build the tools artists live in. DCC scripts, engine editor extensions, one-click export, automated asset validation — every hour you save someone in Maya or the material editor goes back into the game, so treat tooling as a first-class deliverable, not a side project

 - Raise the visual bar alongside the art team. Sit in look-dev with the art director, build the lighting and post-process templates that make the style reproducible, and close the gap between the concept on the wall and the thing running on device

 - Keep art content within budget. Profile real builds on real phones, work out why the device is getting hot, and design the LOD and quality-tier systems that let the game scale from flagship to low-end without losing its identity

 - Prototype the risky visual ideas. Before anyone commits to them, and be honest about which ones won't survive contact with the frame budget

 - Be the interface to the engine team. Translate what artists want into renderer features programmers can scope, and translate what the renderer does into constraints artists can work with

 - Set and hold the standards. Define how art content should be built, document it, onboard people onto the pipeline, and be the person who notices when things start slipping
   
   


WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 8+ years in games, a meaningful chunk of it on the technical side of art

 - Real shader authoring skill — HLSL, Unreal's material graph, or both — and enough scripting (Python, Blueprint, or C++) to build your own tools rather than request them

 - A working mental model of how a frame gets rendered, and of where Unreal's content pipeline hides its costs

 - Fluency across the DCC stack (Maya, Blender, Houdini, Substance, or your equivalents) and strong opinions about how they should connect to the engine

 - The instinct to profile before optimizing, and the patience to chase a regression to its actual cause

 - Comfort being the translation layer between two disciplines that don't always speak the same language — and the diplomacy that takes

 - A self-starter approach to use AI: you've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge

 - Being a great teammate — we believe making games is a team sport
   
   


WOULD BE NICE IF YOU ALSO HAVE

 - At least one shipped mobile title, and the scars to prove it — thermal throttling, bandwidth ceilings, memory budgets, the whole set

 - A history of extending the Unreal editor when the existing workflow wasn't good enough

 - Hands-on experience with AI agents and AI-assisted workflows, especially pointed at content or tooling problems

 - Experience across the full arc of a project, from grey-box prototype to live service, and a sense of what matters at each stage
   
   


WHERE YOU'LL BE

This role is based in our Shanghai office. If you are not local, our relocation team would be excited to help you with your move to Shanghai,China. We provide comprehensive support not only for you, but also for your family!



–––

That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read. 

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page. 

–––



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/7f048a7e-2800-4412-9b99-1a3b978c0413/banner_narrow_allstars.jpg]

About Supercell
Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices https://supr.cl/jd-offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, Brawl Stars, and Squad Busters. Our mission is to create great games https://supr.cl/jd-games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/48e75b93-58a2-46bd-ae28-70a841bcedfd/banner_narrow_shanghai2.jpg]

The Shanghai studio
As Supercell’s first international game development studio, the Shanghai studio is one of the most exciting things happening in Supercell and a unique opportunity to join at a relatively early stage to help shape our path. Our vision is to be a world-class international studio, making new global hit games while leveraging the unique advantages of the game development scene in China and broader Asia.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/d822e263-a735-4e85-b0d1-55ec97d1a05a/banner_narrow_people3.jpg]

Hey, you Might Love It Here!
Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture https://supr.cl/jd-why-you. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/33e38641-694b-41b2-b90e-997ee0941fe1/banner_narrow_titles.jpg]

You Are Not Your Job Title ™
Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles https://supr.cl/jd-job-title or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/114607f3-15f4-4c55-8587-d4d843335f7f/banner_narrow_chest.jpg]

Benefits and Compensation
Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits https://supr.cl/jd-benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/3fdeff1e-ef28-4879-8f80-54c8c5590973/banner_narrow_relocating.jpg]

Relocation? Yes!
No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/990cd84a-76e3-498d-82a1-afc3c6dd608d/banner_narrow_portraits-2026%20(1).jpg]

Not sure if you should apply?
Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.

Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team



P.S. Here's a video about what we do. (Best enjoyed with salmiakki and rye bread)

job.description:
Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.
 With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.
 This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.
 What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world's best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor.
 Since the start, we've raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who've built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.
 At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.
 The opportunity
 As an AI Unity Tools Engineer, you'll build the next generation of QA automation and development tooling for Homa's games. This is a new, high-impact initiative, and you'll own it: from the first question to the tools running in production across our portfolio.
 You’ll work across AI, Unity, QA automation, DevOps, and infrastructure to make testing and build pipelines more reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient for games developed by Homa and its studios. You'll be working on AI-driven QA automation at the edge of what is technically possible, and you'll see the impact directly in the speed, reliability, and cost of how our games are made.

What you'll do
 
- Build. Design and deploy AI-enabled QA automation pipelines across Homa's major Unity games.

- Run. Maintain and improve our TeamCity build pipelines and infrastructure so game builds stay reliable.

- Scale. Onboard new games and tools onto the platform without reducing service quality.

- Explore. Test AI-driven approaches to QA that cut manual testing effort and reduce reliance on costly legacy tooling.

- Drive adoption. Work with developers, QA teams, studios, and mobile teams so the tools you build are actually used.

- Measure. Track the impact of your work on testing time, build reliability, and cost, and turn it into clear recommendations.
 Requirements 
 
- Ownership. You drive outcomes. When a build breaks or a test fails, you fix it instead of explaining why it broke.

- Proactive. You don't wait for instructions or perfect conditions. You spot what needs doing and do it.

- Pragmatism and simplicity. You look for the simplest solution that works, use whatever tools are available, and ship. You turn ambitious ideas into practical, achievable solutions.

- Sharp thinking. You learn fast, reason from facts, and structure your ideas clearly. You can explain a complex technical solution to developers, QA teams, and studios in a few sentences.

- AI-driven. AI is already part of how you work every day. You've used it to automate, speed up, or rethink at least one thing you're proud of.

- Hungry and motivated. You're ambitious, high-energy, and grounded. You see this role as a chance to build something new and grow faster than anywhere else, and you're ready to work for it.

- Bonus: you've built something. An internal tool, a testing framework, a game, a side project. We'd love to hear about it.
 For this role, you'll also bring
 
- Hands-on experience with Unity and the ability to understand Unity games, game systems, and testing contexts.

- Proven experience using AI systems, models, or AI-enabled engineering workflows in practice.

- Strong DevOps understanding, including TeamCity, build pipelines, and infrastructure.

- The ability to work across technical topics while understanding the wider product and business context.

- Experience working in a complex environment with meaningful product and testing volumes.
 Bonus points if you have:
 
- Experience building QA automation or testing frameworks.

- Experience with AI-driven exploratory testing.

- Experience in gaming or another Unity-based product environment.

- Experience supporting products with high testing volumes.

- Experience driving adoption of internal tools across multiple teams.
 Even if you don't check every box, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.
 
 Why Homa
 
- Exceptional growth. We hire people of outstanding potential, then put them where they can grow fastest.

- Real ownership, early. This is a new initiative. Your tools will change how Homa and its studios build and test games, and you'll see the results.

- A high talent bar. Our teams are small and demanding, and the people around you will push you to grow.

- AI at the core. You'll have access to the best AI tools, and you'll help shape how an AI-first company works.
 Benefits 
 Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here's what you can expect:
 
- 🏥 Comprehensive Benefits: Depending on your location, you'll enjoy a range of perks such as insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym memberships, and more.

- 🏢 Paris HQ Access: Enjoy a desk at our private office in a well-located WeWork building that will give you access to WeWork perks like rooftop view and designed coworking spaces.

- 🌍 Coworking Access: You will have access to WeWork spaces throughout Europe, along with all their perks and professional office environments.

- 🌐 Global Team: Collaborate in English with top-tier talent from 35+ countries, spanning Europe, the UK, the US, and more. Diversity fuels our creativity and innovation.

- ✈️ Team Gatherings: We value time together beyond the screen. Join us for occasional team gatherings, off-site retreats (Workations as we name them) to connect, recharge, and celebrate.

- 📈 Performance Reviews: We're committed to your growth. Every six months, we reflect on your progress, recognize your achievements, and align on clear development goals.

- 💻 Equipment Support: From day one, we'll provide everything you need to do your best work, including a home office setup allowance if you're working remotely.
 Where We Hire
 Our HQ in Paris is a vibrant hub of creativity, collaboration, and connection. From rooftop lunches and coffee chats to after-work apéros and community events, we've designed a space people genuinely enjoy - all within a cosy WeWork filled with good energy (and snacks).

- Own people management for your team: run performance reviews, support career growth, and create the conditions for a high-performing, engaged engineering team

- Deliver as a senior IC on live technical projects: write production-quality Unity code, contribute to architecture decisions, and drive implementation on impactful features

- Lead AI adoption within the team: proactively test and embed new AI tools, share wins, and accelerate the team’s ability to use what’s possible

- Act as a technical knowledge multiplier: identify automation opportunities, expand the team’s understanding of backend and AI systems, and raise engineering standards continuously

- Manage a live, scaling game with production care: balance technical ambition with revenue-conscious delivery, ensuring changes are robust, measured, and safe to ship
 This is a great opportunity to own both the technical and human side of a small, elite team, shape how AI transforms day-to-day engineering on a live product, and make a direct, visible impact on a game played by millions.
 
 Requirements 
 We are looking for someone with proven experience as a senior Unity engineer who has also led and grown engineering teams, and the humility, curiosity, ambition, and drive to make an impact fast. You’re a great fit if you have:
 
- Senior Unity expertise: you write clean, robust Unity/C# code, own architecture decisions, and set the technical standard for your team

- Proven engineering management experience: you’ve led engineers through hiring, performance cycles, and day-to-day management, and you do it with structure and empathy

- Clear, adaptable communication: you know how to translate technical complexity for any audience and keep collaboration sharp across functions

- Active AI curiosity: you test tools on your own initiative, understand what’s possible, and think constantly about how AI can accelerate your team’s output

- Strong ownership mindset: you go beyond your defined scope, spot problems before they’re raised, and drive solutions without waiting to be asked

- Problem-solving depth: you break down complex technical challenges, structure clear hypotheses, and execute with rigour
 Bonus points if you have: 
 
- Experience shipping and maintaining live, revenue-generating mobile games, especially puzzle games at scale

- Backend or server-side knowledge that enhances your ability to build AI-powered workflows and automations

- A track record of navigating technically complex changes on a live product under production constraints
 Even if you don’t check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we’re more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.
 Our Culture
 Benefits 
 At Homa, we prioritize talent, energy, and determination over traditional credentials. We’re building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, act with pragmatism, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values:
 
- Humility: We recognise that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow - we stay grounded in a clear view of ourselves.

- Curiosity: We continuously seek the “why” behind the “what” , we explore with purpose and practicality.

- Focus: Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider - we obsess over the details and let pragmatism guide our attention.

- Ambition: We strive for the best - we don’t settle for “good enough,” , we use common sense to reach higher.
 
 Benefits 
 Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here’s what you can expect:
 
- Comprehensive Benefits: Depending on your location, you’ll enjoy a range of perks such as insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym memberships, and more.

- Paris HQ Access: Enjoy a desk at our private office in a well-located WeWork building that will give you access to WeWork perks like rooftop view and designed coworking spaces.

- Coworking Access: You will have access to WeWork spaces throughout Europe, along with all their perks and professional office environments.

- Global Team: Collaborate in English with top-tier talent from 35+ countries, spanning Europe, the UK, the US, and more. Diversity fuels our creativity and innovation.

- ✈️ Team Gatherings: We value time together beyond the screen. Join us for occasional team gatherings, off-site retreats (Workations as we name them) to connect, recharge, and celebrate.

- Performance Reviews: We’re committed to your growth. Every six months, we reflect on your progress, recognize your achievements, and align on clear development goals.

- Equipment Support: From day one, we’ll provide everything you need to do your best work, including a home office setup allowance if you’re working remotely.
 Where We Hire
 Our HQ in Paris is a vibrant hub of creativity, collaboration, and connection. From rooftop lunches and coffee chats to after-work apéros and community events, we’ve designed a space people genuinely enjoy - all within a cosy WeWork filled with good energy (and snacks).
 We also have incredible team members across Europe - from Spain and Turkey to Germany, North Macedonia, Poland, the UK, and more. Whether you’re working from a sunny WeWork in Barcelona or your home setup in Warsaw, you’re fully part of our culture. To keep collaboration smooth, we primarily hire within European time zones (UTC to UTC+3). If you’re based there - or planning to be - we’d love to hear from you!
