job.description:
ABOUT US 

 Eterio Realities Inc. is a software company in Victoria, British Columbia, building augmented reality tools for industrial manufacturing. Our story began in 2010, out of challenges encountered during the construction of the Sparkling Hill Resort in Vernon, B.C.

 Today we’re a team of 30+ across Canada and India, and growing. We have built FabStation , an AR-enabled manufacturing execution system used by 200+ fabrication shops in 30+ countries. FabStation replaces paper and 2D drawings on the shop floor with AR-guided assembly, dimensional inspection, and production tracking, and it integrates with the workflows shops already run. Our mission is to empower steel fabricators with innovative augmented reality technology, revolutionizing the way they work.

 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 We are looking for an Intermediate XR 3D Engineer to join our Engineering team. You’ll build features for FabStation that fabricators use every day on the shop floor, across HoloLens 2 and tablets. You’ll be part of a small, collaborative team, working with product, QA and back-end developers. The role combines R&D on new and emerging XR technology with keeping a production codebase reliable. You will own features end to end, from technical design through release.

 WHAT YOU'LL DO:

- Design and develop new FabStation features in Unity 3D and C#, for both AR headsets (such as HoloLens 2) and tablet apps.

- Design the user interface and experience for the AR and tablet apps, including menus, layouts, 3D interactions, and gesture and touch controls.

- Plan the technical design of new Unity features so they are easy to extend and maintain.

- Keep the existing Unity codebase stable, Fix bugs and connect the apps to the FabStation back end and cloud services. 

- Estimate their own tasks and raise problems early.

- Write clear documentation for their work.

 WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

- Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

- Minimum 5 years of professional software development experience.

- Minimum 3 years of professional Unity 3D development experience.

- Strong C# programming skills, including object-oriented programming, debugging, and code refactoring.

- Hands-on experience developing AR/MR/XR applications using Unity.

- Experience developing, testing, and deploying applications on Microsoft HoloLens 2 or similar MR/XR devices.

- Experience deploying AR applications to mobile phones and tablets (Android/iOS).

- Experience debugging, troubleshooting, fixing bugs, and optimizing application performance.

- Demonstrated ownership and accountability for delivering software features from development through deployment.

 NICE TO HAVES:

- • Experience with Vuforia Engine, including image tracking, object tracking, or model targets.

- • Experience with MRTK (Mixed Reality Toolkit) for HoloLens 2 development.

- • Knowledge of spatial mapping, hand tracking, and mixed-reality interactions.

- • Experience integrating CAD models or complex 3D models into Unity.

- • Advanced shader development experience using HLSL, ShaderLab, or Shader Graph.

- • Experience optimizing Unity applications for standalone MR/XR devices.

 WHAT WE OFFER:

- Competitive salary: $75,000-85,000 CAD

- Comprehensive benefits package – Medical, Dental, & Vision. 

- Paid sick/personal days annually. 

- $2,000 CAD tech stipend. 

- Fully remote work environment

- Company-wide holiday week closure over Christmas

 Thank you to all applicants. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted, and everyone we interview will hear back from us on the outcome . 

 This posting is for an existing vacancy. We do not use artificial intelligence to screen, assess or select applicants.

 As an equal opportunity employer, Eterio Realities truly stands behind diversity and are committed to creating an environment of inclusion where hiring decisions are based on merit and business needs and without regard to race, colour, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Eterio Realities also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law. 

Salary: $75,000 – $85,000 / year Originally posted on Himalayas

job.description:
Position Type: Full-Time
 Location: Remote
 Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours 
 About the Role
 We’re looking for a Video Game Developer to build, iterate, and maintain game projects using both Unity and Godot . You’ll work closely with designers and artists to turn creative concepts into polished gameplay systems, mechanics, and interactions while taking ownership of features from prototype through delivery.
 Key Responsibilities
 Game Development

- Develop and maintain games using Unity (C#) and Godot (GDScript or C#) .

- Write clean, maintainable code for stable and shippable builds.

- Work across multiple game projects as needed.

 Feature Development

- Translate design concepts and creative direction into playable mechanics and systems.

- Take ownership of features from initial prototypes through polished implementation.

- Build gameplay interactions, systems, and supporting functionality.

 Debugging & Optimization

- Identify and resolve bugs, performance issues, and technical debt.

- Optimize game systems and builds for target platforms.

- Investigate technical issues and deliver reliable fixes.

 Technical Documentation

- Document game systems, scripts, and architecture decisions.

- Create clear documentation that allows other team members to understand and maintain your work.

 Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with designers and artists to align technical implementation with creative direction.

- Communicate progress, technical decisions, and blockers clearly.

- Participate in focused team discussions and async collaboration.

 Required Experience & Skills

- Hands-on professional or portfolio experience developing games in both Unity and Godot .

- Strong C# experience with Unity.

- Experience with GDScript or C# in Godot.

- Shipped games or strong portfolio projects demonstrating your development experience.

- Understanding of game architecture, including:

- State machines

- Component systems

- Scene management

- Input handling

- Ability to independently translate design requirements into technical solutions.

- Experience using Git and collaborative branching workflows.

- Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.

- Clear written English communication for technical discussions and documentation.

 Perfect Fit / Culture

- Comfortable working through ambiguity and making thoughtful technical decisions.

- Takes ownership from the first commit through final polish.

- Communicates proactively and keeps teammates informed.

- Detail-oriented and committed to delivering high-quality game experiences.

- Able to work independently while collaborating effectively with creative and technical team members.

 Typical Day
 You’ll spend most of your day focused on active game development across one or more projects. You may build a new mechanic in Godot, review how it fits into existing systems, document your approach, or switch to a Unity project to investigate and fix a technical issue.
 You’ll collaborate with designers and artists through written updates and focused check-ins while maintaining a strong focus on hands-on development.
 Interview Process

- AI Screening 

- Client Interview 

- Offer Stage

¿Te apasionan los videojuegos, la programación y el desarrollo de videojuegos ? Comparte tus conocimientos y ayuda a otras personas a convertir sus ideas en sus propios videojuegos.
 En Tusclasesparticulares buscamos Game Developers, programadores/as y especialistas en desarrollo de videojuegos para impartir clases particulares a estudiantes de diferentes edades y niveles.
 Tareas

- Impartir clases de desarrollo de videojuegos adaptadas al nivel y objetivos de cada alumno.

- Enseñar programación y herramientas utilizadas en el desarrollo de videojuegos.

- Trabajar contenidos como programación de videojuegos, diseño de juegos, Unity, Unreal Engine, desarrollo 2D y 3D .

- Acompañar a los alumnos en la creación de sus propios proyectos.

- Explicar conceptos de programación, debugging y resolución de problemas.

- Preparar ejercicios y proyectos prácticos adaptados a cada estudiante.

- Ayudar a desarrollar proyectos personales, académicos o portfolios.

 Requisitos

- Formación o experiencia en Desarrollo de Videojuegos, Informática, Programación, Game Design o áreas relacionadas.

- Se valorará experiencia con Unity, Unreal Engine u otros motores de videojuegos.

- No es necesaria experiencia previa impartiendo clases.

- Capacidad para explicar conceptos técnicos de forma clara y práctica.

- Pasión por los videojuegos, la tecnología y la enseñanza.

 Beneficios

- Horario totalmente flexible.

- Posibilidad de teletrabajar impartiendo clases online o combinar con clases presenciales.

- Retribución de 15 a 30 €/hora .

- Tú decides tu disponibilidad, el número de alumnos y las clases que quieres impartir.

- Una excelente oportunidad para compaginar esta actividad con tu trabajo en el sector tecnológico, estudios o proyectos propios de desarrollo de videojuegos.

- Guardrails & UX: Develop the "logic layer" that sits between raw AI outputs and the player, ensuring content remains on-theme, safe, and balanced within the game's mechanics.

- Rapid Gameplay Iteration: Use GenAI to accelerate the "find the fun" phase of development, building internal tools that allow for faster level blocking, asset variation, and playtesting loops.

- Technical Troubleshooting: Debug complex interactions where AI systems meet deterministic game logic, maintaining the stability of the live game environment.

 Qualifications

- Gameplay Engineering Core: 5+ years of professional experience in game development. You have a deep understanding of game architecture, player controllers, and real-time systems.

- Applied GenAI Skills: Proven experience using LLMs or Diffusion models to solve specific product problems. You know how to prompt, fine-tune, and chain models to get predictable results in an unpredictable game world.

- Systems Thinker: You understand how a change in an AI's "personality" or "generation parameters" affects game balance and the overall player journey.

- Technical Proficiency: Expert-level C++ or C# (Unity/Unreal) and a grasp of Python for tooling and data pipelines.

- Passion for Innovation: You are excited by "impossible" design challenges and believe GenAI is the key to unlocking new genres of play.

ABOUT THE ROLE: 
 We are seeking an Analytics Engineer to join our Analytics Platform team to design, build and maintain scalable data products that power our Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) and Care Navigation organizations. In this role, you will be responsible for transforming complex healthcare data into trusted, analytics ready datasets that support operational reporting, client insights, financial analysis and strategic decision-making. You will partner closely with Analytics, Data Engineering, Clinical, Client Success, Product and Operations teams to build reliable and scalable data models within our data foundry. 
 This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about analytics engineering, has strong dbt expertise, enjoys solving complex healthcare data challenges and thinks beyond individual requests to build reusable and maintainable systems. 
 You will play a key role in shaping the future of our data platform by developing high-quality data products, establishing engineering best practices, and helping the organization evolve toward AI-enabled and self-service analytics capabilities. 
 WHAT YOU’LL DO: 

- Apply hands on analytics and data expertise to solve complex, fast moving financial and operational problems in the health tech space 

- Design, develop and maintain scalable, analytics ready data models (primarily in dbt) that power a PBM and care navigation data ecosystem that support client reporting, performance analytics, operational analysis and self-service business intelligence. 

- Translate complex pharmacy benefits and healthcare navigation workflows, business rules and operational processes into transparent, maintainable, and auditable data models. 

- Partner closely with data and analytics engineers, data analysts and business stakeholders to deliver reliable data products that can be leveraged across multiple use cases and continuously optimize data models and warehouse performance to support large-scale PBM/care navigation datasets and growing business needs. 

- Implement automated data quality checks, testing frameworks and reconciliation processes to ensure data reliability. 

- Establish documentation standards, lineage and analytics engineering guardrails that promote transparency and auditability. 

- Contribute to engineering best practices including version control, CI/CD, incremental models, code reviews, and observability. 

- Contribute to data governance by establishing modeling standards, documentation and guardrails that support auditability, explainability and long term maintainability. 

- Build data foundations that enable future agentic analytics engineering use cases, including self-service analytics and AI-assisted insight generation. 

- Stay informed on emerging technologies and identify opportunities to incorporate AI into analytics engineering workflows. 

 WHO YOU ARE: 

- 3+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data modeling, data warehousing or a related field. 

- Strong experience with dbt (core or cloud) and modern analytics engineering best practices (required). 

- Advanced SQL proficiency and experience developing data transformations and workflows using python. 

- Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, medallion architecture, semantic modeling and scalable data architecture principles. 

- Experience building and maintaining production-grade data models, data quality tests, and documentation. 

- Experience working with cloud data warehouses such as Amazon Redshift, Snowflake, or BigQuery. 

- Experience orchestrating and monitoring data pipelines using tools such as Apache Airflow., Dagster etc. 

- Experience working within cloud environments, preferably AWS. 

- Familiarity with software engineering practices including Git, CI/CD, pull request reviews, testing, and deployment workflows. 

- Interest or experience in leveraging AI-enabled development workflows and analytics tooling, including experience with or willingness to learn technologies such as claude, claude skills, Model Context Protocol (MCP) and AI assisted engineering practices. 

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with a focus on building scalable, maintainable data solutions. 

- Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical 

 COMPENSATION: $120,000 - $150,000 annually, in addition to bonus and equity 
 Compensation offered will be determined by geographic location, experience, and qualifications. 
 
 CYBERSECURITY AWARENESS NOTICE

 HOW WE LIVE OUR VALUES TO OUR TEAMMATES:

job.description:
Gameloft Montréal recherche un(e) Artiste technique pour rejoindre l'équipe qui travaille sur Disney Dreamlight Valley, un jeu hybride de simulation de vie et d'aventure multiplateforme !
 Rempli de quêtes, d'exploration et d'activités captivantes avec des personnages emblématiques de Disney et Pixar, Disney Dreamlight Valley est une production originale de Gameloft Montréal créée par une équipe passionnée impatiente de vous accueillir !
 Pour en savoir plus sur le jeu : 
 Bande-annonce : 
 officiel : 
 Sous la supervision du Chef technique, et en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de programmation et artistique, l'Artiste technique conçoit des outils et développe un pipeline de production graphique optimal pour soutenir le processus de création de son équipe pour le contenu actuel et à venir. Il ou elle veille à répondre à toutes les attentes artistiques et de design, dans le respect des contraintes de performance et des délais de production.
 Principales tâches et responsabilités
 Pipeline et outils

- Superviser et tenir à jour le pipeline des ressources artistiques, et détecter les problèmes avant qu'ils n'atteignent une version.

- Développer et tenir à jour des outils de création numérique qui appliquent les conventions de nomenclature, les budgets de triangles, les dispositions UV, etc.

- Créer et maintenir les paramètres d'importation côté moteur (modèles, compression des textures, etc.).

 Performance et optimisation

- Établir des budgets par asset (nombre de triangles, densité de texels, nombre de matériaux, etc.) par scène ou par classe d'assets, et vérifier les nouvelles soumissions d'assets par rapport à ces budgets avant que les dépassements ne s'accumulent dans tout le projet.

- Profiler les versions sur le matériel cible et traduire les résultats en étapes exploitables.

- Optimiser des assets spécifiques en cas de besoin.

 Shaders et matériaux

- Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les programmeurs graphiques pour créer et tenir à jour la bibliothèque de shaders du projet en utilisant à la fois le Shader Graph et le HLSL.

- Collaborer avec le Directeur artistique pour prototyper de nouveaux effets visuels et travailler avec l'équipe artistique pour les intégrer au projet.

- Examiner et corriger les bugs de matériaux/shaders (artefacts de profondeur et de tri, artefacts de mosaïquage, réponse PBR incorrecte, etc.).

- Valider les configurations de matériaux dans différentes conditions d'éclairage et sur les plateformes cibles.

 Normes de l'équipe artistique

- Rédiger et mettre à jour les sections techniques du guide artistique (conventions de nomenclature, spécifications d'exportation, formats de textures, structure des dossiers, considérations d'optimisation, etc.), qui sont cruciales pour les artistes internes et les partenaires en sous-traitance.

- Former les nouveaux artistes aux outils de pipeline et appliquer les normes.

- Assumer le triage initial de tous les problèmes d'intégration des ressources.

- Définir et spécifier les demandes et caractéristiques du nouveau pipeline artistique.

- Évaluer et recommander de nouveaux outils, plugins et mises à niveau du pipeline.

 ---
 Gameloft Montreal is looking for a Technical Artist to join the team working on Disney Dreamlight Valley, a cross-platform hybrid life-sim/adventure game!
 Filled with quests, exploration, and engaging activities featuring iconic Disney and Pixar characters, Disney Dreamlight Valley is an original Gameloft Montreal production created by a passionate team eager to welcome you!
 To learn more about the game: 
 Trailer: 
 website: 
 Under the supervision of the technical lead, and working closely with the programming and art teams, the technical artist designs tools and develops an optimal graphics production pipeline to support their team's creation process for existing and upcoming content. They make sure to meet any artistic/design expectations, in keeping with performance constraints and production deadlines.
 Main Tasks and Responsibilities
 Pipeline & Tooling

- Monitor and maintain the art asset pipeline, and catch issues before they reach a build.

- Write and maintain DCC tools that enforce naming conventions, triangle budgets, UV layouts, etc.

- Author and maintain engine-side import settings (models, texture compression, etc.).

 Performance & Optimization

- Establish per-asset budgets (triangle count, texel density, material count, etc.) per scene or asset class, and audit new asset submissions against them before violations compound across the project.

- Profile builds on target hardware and translate the findings into actionable steps.

- Optimize specific assets when needed.

 Shaders & Materials

- Work closely with the Graphics Programmers to author and maintain the project shader library using both Shader Graph and HLSL.

- Collaborate with the Art Director to prototype new visual effects and work with the art team to integrate them in the project.

- Investigate and fix material/shader bugs (depth and sorting artifacts, tiling artifacts, incorrect PBR response, etc.).

- Validate material setups across lighting conditions and target platforms.

 Art Team Standards

- Write and maintain the Art Bible's technical sections (naming conventions, export specs, texture formats, folder structure, optimization considerations, etc.), which are critical for internal artists and outsourcing partners.

- Onboard new artists to pipeline tools and enforce standards.

- Own first-response triage for all art-to-engine issues.

- Scope and spec new art pipeline requests and features.

- Evaluate and recommend new tools, plugins, and pipeline upgrades.

- Expérience de contribution à un pipeline artistique sur un projet livré

- Expérience de publication sur au moins une plateforme console (Nintendo Switch™, PS5® ou Xbox Series) et expérience pratique avec les contraintes spécifiques à la mémoire et aux shaders de la plateforme

- Compétence avec Git et SVN, et à l'aise avec les flux de travail basés sur les demandes de fusion

 Moteur et pipeline

- Solide compétence avec Unity (URP), avec une expérience pratique dans plusieurs de ses systèmes (rendu, pipeline d'assets, profilage, débogage)

- Compétence en C# pour les outils d'éditeur (inspecteurs personnalisés, validateurs, traitements en lots)

- Expérience en rédaction ou maintenance d'outils de validation d'assets

- À l'aise avec le travail sur les préréglages d'importation et les substitutions de plateforme (compression des textures, compression des maillages)

 Outils de création numérique

- Expérience de l'écriture de scripts dans au moins un des langages suivants : 3ds Max, Blender ou Maya (exportateurs, outils par lots, validation, nettoyage de scènes)

- Familiarité avec les flux de travail de Substance 3D Painter/Designer

 Shaders et matériaux

- Solide expérience en HLSL dans URP, y compris les shaders personnalisés illuminés/non illuminés et les mots-clés de shader

- À l'aise avec Shader Graph et comprend quand l'écriture manuelle en HLSL est une meilleure option

- Bonne compréhension de la PBR, des espaces colorimétriques et du comportement de l'éclairage sur les différentes plateformes

- Expérience de débogage des problèmes de shaders sur diverses plateformes

 Performance et profilage

- Expérience pratique avec les outils de profilage et de débogage GPU tels que Unity Frame Debugger et Nsight, et capable de lire une capture d'image fixe pour identifier les goulots d'étranglement GPU courants (appels de dessin, taux de remplissage, coûts des shaders)

- Expérience de travail avec des budgets par asset et par scène (triangles, densité des texels, nombre de matériaux, surdessin, mémoire) et pour les faire respecter

 Normes et communication

- Expérience dans la rédaction et la mise à jour de la documentation technique liée à l'art (sections du guide artistique, guides des pipelines)

- À l'aise pour guider les artistes sur les meilleures pratiques techniques et examiner leur travail quant à la conformité au pipeline

- À l'aise en tant que premier point de contact pour les artistes rencontrant des problèmes avec le moteur

- Capable de définir la portée d'une demande de fonctionnalité pour un pipeline, rédiger une spécification succincte, l'évaluer et la livrer

 Atouts

- Expérience dans le soutien des pipelines d'installation et d'animation (résolution de problèmes et révision de contenu)

- Expérience dans le soutien des effets visuels (résolution de problèmes, optimisation et révision de contenu)

- Familiarité avec Houdini (pipelines procéduraux, HDA) ou autres outils de contenu procédural

- Expérience avec les shaders de calcul (systèmes d'herbe/particules, instanciation GPU, dessin indirect, etc.)

- Expérience avec les pipelines d'éclairage (sondes lumineuses, flux de travail de cuisson, outils d'auteur de sondes)

- Familiarité avec Jira/Confluence pour la gestion des problèmes et le pipeline de documentation

- Expérience précédente en tant qu'artiste avant de passer à l'art technique

 ---

- Experience contributing to an art pipeline on a shipped project

- Experience shipping on at least one console platform (Nintendo Switch™, PS5® or Xbox Series) and hands-on experience with platform-specific memory and shader constraints

- Proficient with Git and SVN, and comfortable with merge-request-based workflows

 Engine & Pipeline

- Strong Unity proficiency (URP), with hands-on experience in several of its systems (rendering, asset pipeline, profiling, debugging)

- Proficient in C# for editor tooling (custom inspectors, validators, batch processors)

- Experience writing or maintaining asset validation tools

- Comfortable working with import presets and platform overrides (texture compression, mesh compression)

 DCC Tools

- Experience writing scripts in at least one of the following: 3ds Max, Blender, or Maya (exporters, batch tools, validation, scene cleanup)

- Familiarity with Substance 3D Painter/Designer workflows

 Shaders & Materials

- Solid HLSL experience in URP, including custom lit/unlit shaders and shader keywords

- Comfortable in Shader Graph and understands when handwritten HLSL is a better option

- Good understanding of PBR, color spaces, and how lighting behaves across platforms

- Experience debugging shader issues across platforms

 Performance & Profiling

- Hands-on experience with GPU profiling and debugging tools such as Unity Frame Debugger and Nsight, and able to read a frame capture to identify common GPU bottlenecks (draw calls, fillrate, shader costs)

- Experience working with per-asset and per-scene budgets (triangles, texel density, material count, overdraw, memory) and helping enforce them

 Standards & Communication

- Experience writing and maintaining technical art documentation (Art Bible sections, pipeline guides)

- Comfortable guiding artists on technical best practices and reviewing their work for pipeline compliance

- Comfortable as the first point of contact for artists who have encountered engine issues

- Able to scope a pipeline feature request, write a short spec, estimate, and ship it

 Nice to Have

- Experience supporting rigging and animation pipelines (troubleshooting issues and content review)

- Experience supporting VFX (troubleshooting, optimization and content review)

- Familiarity with Houdini (procedural pipelines, HDAs) or other procedural content tools

- Compute shader experience (grass/particle systems, GPU instancing, indirect draw, etc.)

- Experience with lighting pipelines (light probes, baking workflows, probe authoring tools)

- Familiarity with Jira/Confluence for issue triage and pipeline documentation

- Previous experience as an artist before moving into tech art

En nous rejoignant, vous aurez une multitudes d'opportunités pour aider votre environnement, faire la différence et bâtir un monde plus inclusif.

job.description:
We believe AI will fundamentally change how games are built and played, from content creation to player experience, and we’re building at the frontier of that shift.

 Puzzle Cats builds casual mobile games played by tens of millions of people worldwide. We’re a small, high-performing team that moves faster than most studios think is possible, taking games from concept to App Store quickly and continuously iterating on live games with millions of active players.

 We’re looking for an AI Product Engineer who wants to build something big and move fast. This is a hands-on, highly product-oriented role for someone who wants to invent, ship, and scale AI-native game experiences. You’ll work across the full development process, from prototype to production, collaborating with designers, engineers, and product teams to launch new games and improve live ones. Features you build can reach millions of players within weeks.

 We’re especially interested in engineers who don’t just tolerate AI tools, they live inside them. Someone who naturally uses tools like Claude, Cursor, OpenAI, or coding agents as part of how they build, understands the code they generate, and knows when to prompt a solution versus writing it from scratch.

 You’ll own features end-to-end, from gameplay systems and backend infrastructure to analytics, building, shipping, measuring, and iterating quickly based on real player data. We ship fast, test aggressively, and aren’t afraid to kill ideas — including AI ones — if the data doesn’t support them.

 What You’ll Do 

- Use AI to create new player experiences that wouldn’t be possible otherwise

- Build and ship mobile game features in Unity (C#) for iOS and Android, including gameplay mechanics, onboarding flows, monetization experiments, and live-ops systems

- Prototype and launch new game ideas quickly, moving from concept to playable builds in weeks, not months

- Design and build AI-powered gameplay and product features, including content generation, personalization, and AI-driven mechanics

- Design and implement AI systems and pipelines, including RAG, embeddings, tool use, and agents

- Optimize AI systems for cost, latency, and scalability, including token usage, caching, and model selection

- Develop and maintain backend systems for live games, including leaderboards, events, A/B testing infrastructure, and cloud services (GCP/Firebase)

- Collaborate closely with designers and analysts to interpret player data and turn insights into gameplay improvements

- Own the full lifecycle of your features, including implementation, analytics instrumentation, debugging, and performance optimization

- Review code and maintain high engineering standards, including AI-generated code

 Must-Haves 

- Strong problem-solving ability, a hacker mindset, and deep object-oriented programming knowledge

- Ability to write clean, maintainable code and move quickly without sacrificing quality

- Experience integrating real AI features into products, not just using AI tools, but shipping or meaningfully prototyping model-driven functionality

- Experience integrating LLMs into production systems using OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models

- Strong intuition for how LLMs behave, including prompt design, failure modes, and output quality

- Experience building and iterating on AI features using real user data

- 3+ years of production software engineering experience, ideally with shipped mobile apps or games built in Unity (C#) for iOS and Android

- Experience with Python or JavaScript, cloud infrastructure/back-end systems, and Git

- Ability to analyze player data and metrics to improve gameplay and product decisions

- Strong critical thinking, communication skills, and empathy for players

- Comfort working in ambiguity and figuring things out without playbooks

- Ability to go from idea to prototype to production in days or weeks, not months

 Nice to Have 

- Experience applying AI to gameplay systems, including procedural content generation or LLM-driven systems such as personalization, dialogue, level generation, or dynamic difficulty

- Experience designing AI pipelines such as RAG, embeddings/vector search, and tool use/function calling

- Experience fine-tuning or working with open-source models

- Game design sensibility and a strong feel for what makes mechanics engaging

- Experience with Python scripting for tooling, automation, or data pipelines

- Experience optimizing Unity mobile performance, including memory profiling, draw call optimization, and frame-rate debugging

- Experience shipping multiple mobile game titles

 What Success Looks Like in Your First 30 Days 

- 
 Days 1–7: Ship your first feature or fix to a live game and get familiar with the full stack

- 
 Days 7–14: Contribute to a new game prototype and help improve a product metric

- 
 Days 14–30: Operate independently and ship at least one improvement that wasn’t originally on the roadmap

job.description:
We've set the standard in kids entertainment. Come help us raise it.
 We're Lingokids , the #1 entertainment platform for young kids. Most kids content is designed to capture attention. We create experiences little ones genuinely love. Everything we make is created in-house to be seriously fun, with the good stuff built in from the very beginning. We're KidSAFE certified, completely ad-free, and committed to giving families entertainment they can trust, with no compromise. Ever.
 20 million kids come back to us every single month, and we’ve earned more than 50 awards along the way. Now we're going after something bigger: becoming the go-to entertainment destination for kids everywhere, and changing what content looks like for the generation growing up on it.
 You in? Keep on reading.
 A hands-on technical artist who owns the path from finished 2D art and animation to working assets in Unity. They build the tools, standards, and validation that make handoffs reliable, keep templates and IP reskins fast, and help the team adopt AI-assisted workflows where they genuinely help.
 The role 
 As Technical Artist, you will own the tooling and standards behind this journey. You'll work directly with discipline leads and Engineering to cut manual work, catch integration errors early, and make sure assets look and behave in playable builds as intended.
 What you'll own

- Evaluate the art and animation pipeline and technical stack, identify visual or creative requirements that existing workflows cannot support, and propose practical solutions or alternatives that align with production constraints.

- Build and maintain tools: Write practical scripts, exporters, importers, and validation checks that remove repetitive work.

- Define asset standards: Set conventions for structure, naming, export settings, versioning, and "ready for implementation" criteria.

- Own Unity asset setup: Define how visual assets and animations are integrated efficiently in Unity, including prefabs, reusable configurations, and animation integration.

- Validate in builds: Check that assets look and behave correctly on device, and diagnose visual defects, integration issues, and mobile performance problems.

- Keep the pipeline healthy: Find bottlenecks, trace recurring issues to their root cause, and fix them across Art, Animation, Design, and Engineering.

- Enable reuse: Structure assets, rigs, animations, and setups so they carry across games, levels, and IP reskins with minimal rework.

- Evolve the workflow: Evaluate new tools and pipeline changes, including our exploration of a move from Adobe Animate to Spine, and help teams adopt them.

- Introduce AI-assisted workflows: Identify where AI tools can safely speed up production, pilot them with the team, set guardrails for quality and licensed-IP use, and document what works.

- Document and support: Write clear documentation, train colleagues, and make tools usable by people with different levels of technical confidence.

 What you'll bring

- Hands-on experience integrating 2D art and animation into Unity for shipped or production-ready games.

- Experience with node-based shader editors (e.g., Amplify Shader Editor, Shader Graph), including creating custom shaders and effects tailored to the creative needs of each project.

- Solid understanding of Unity’s different render pipelines, including their capabilities, limitations, and appropriate use cases.

- A solid grasp of 2D asset and animation pipelines, such as preparing layered art (e.g. PSD or Animate files) for export, sprite or skeletal animation, and atlas packing.

- Scripting ability to automate real production problems. We care more about how you solve them than which language you use. C# for Unity editor tooling is most relevant, and Python or similar for external automation is welcome. If you're strong in one, you can learn the other.

- Practical troubleshooting skills: reproducing issues, isolating causes, and fixing them at the source.

- An understanding of mobile performance constraints such as app size and download, memory, draw calls, texture sizes, and animation cost.

- Practical experience using AI tools, such as coding assistants, to build or speed up production tools, with sound judgment about when output needs human review.

- The ability to work with artists, animators, designers, and engineers, and to explain technical decisions to non-technical colleagues.

- Comfort writing documentation and teaching others.

 Nice to have skills

- Familiarity with Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Animate workflows.

- Asset localization experience: Text baked into art, font and glyph coverage, per-locale asset variants, and how they're packaged are TA problems.

- Version control workflows for art assets.

- Experience building small AI-assisted tools or automations that non-technical colleagues use day to day.

- Experience in games for children, or with licensed IP and brand-approval constraints.

- Experience with templated or reskinnable game systems.

- High experience with Spine or another skeletal 2D animation tool.

 English is a must: We’re a multicultural team providing a service in English , so while certifications aren’t necessary, fluency is essential. As a fully remote company, clear and effective spoken and written communication , especially in asynchronous and long-form formats, is key to collaborating successfully.
 Life at Lingokids 
 📚 Career Growth: Your growth drives our success! We invest in your development up to €2,000 per year for books and training; so you can keep learning and growing with us.
 🏡 Remote-Friendly: Work from where you’re most productive, home or our offices in Madrid, anywhere within a 2-hour difference from Spain (GMT+1) . The choice is yours!
 📈 Stock Options: Your contribution matters! You'll receive stock options , giving you the opportunity to own part of the company and share in its success.
 🖥 Home Office Setup: Create your ideal workspace with a €400 allowance for setup and €35/month for remote work expenses, because comfort fuels creativity!
 🍲 Meal Allowances: Get €60/month on your Cobee card to enjoy meals at restaurants or food delivery, good food makes everything better!
 💳 Flexible Compensation: Manage your meal, transport and childcare expenses easily with Cobee , integrating them directly into your payroll.
 🩺 Health Insurance : Access private health coverage at exclusive rates through Adeslas, seamlessly deducted from your payroll, quality care made simple.
 💬 Language Lessons: Learning never stops! Enjoy free language classes in Spanish and English, to sharpen your skills and stay connected in a global team.
 🌍 Visa Sponsorship: If you need a visa to work in the EU , we’ll handle the process and cover the costs to make your transition seamless.
 🎉 Company events : Yes! We’re a fully remote team spread across different countries, but we love getting together from time to time in different corners of Spain, for team gatherings and recharging at our amazing off-sites!
 Passion matters more than perfection 
 Didn’t check every box for this role? No worries! We’re looking for passionate, driven individuals who believe in our mission. If that sounds like you, we’d still love to hear from you!
 Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion 
 At Lingokids , diversity isn’t just a checkbox—it’s at the heart of everything we do. Just like we teach kids to embrace differences, we celebrate them in our team, knowing that the best ideas come from unique perspectives. We’re all about creating a space where everyone feels valued, heard, and empowered to be their authentic selves. No matter your background, identity, or story, if you’re passionate about making a difference in education, we want you here.

job.description:
About Us
 Streamline Media Group is a 25-year creative development studio specializing in full video game development, co-development, publishing, and interactive digital asset production. We have shipped titles across every major platform for clients, including Sony, Microsoft, and global AAA publishers.
 Description
 Games are being built by people and AI agents together, and we want engineers who are excited by that. You’ll work with our developers, designers, and artists on game systems, engine and pipeline tools, and the web applications that run our productions. You build it, you test it, and you own whether it’s good.
 This is a remote, project-based contract. Scope, timelines, and rates are defined per work order. It is not full-time employment.
 What We Value
 You don’t need all of this. If you’re strong in a few areas and keen to grow into the rest, we’d like to hear from you.

- C++ and game architecture experience in Unity or Unreal.

- Web development with Next.js, React, and TypeScript.

- Hands-on AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Codex, or similar). Best practices are still evolving. At minimum, use AI as an audit tool, and understand what you’re using it for.

- A habit of documenting decisions: ADRs, Markdown specs, agent skills.

- Interest in game design and product strategy. You test the final product, not just the code.

- A practitioner, not a theorist: positive, flexible, and someone who delivers.

 Bonus Points

- Custom engines, or newer engines such as Godot or Bevy.

- Python for DCC tools, CI / build pipelines, Docker, and cloud hosting.

- Online or multiplayer experience.

 How You’ll Be Measured
On-time delivery, outcomes that meet the spec, and staying within the budgeted man-days.
 Streamline Values: Responsibility, accountability, discipline, teamwork, clear communication, continuous improvement, and learning.
 Stay updated on future job opportunities at Streamline Studios by subscribing to our Careers Newsletter

- Effectuer des recherches et mettre en place de nouvelles techniques afin d'améliorer la qualité et les performances des actifs.

- Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes d'art, d'animation, de conception et d'ingénierie afin de résoudre les problèmes liés au pipeline et aux actifs.

- Proposer des outils et des pipelines d'automatisation pour l'itération, l'optimisation et les flux de travail procéduraux.

- Déboguer et profiler les ressources pour garantir les performances sur toutes les plateformes.

- Fournir des commentaires techniques, de la documentation et encadrer d'autres artistes.

- Tech artist role, requiring some basic rigging knowledge and Python scripting.

- Ability to write robust Maya/Mobu tools/scripts and directly support cross-discipline pipelines.

- Expected to interface frequently with stakeholders, guiding conversations around rigging, shaders, and workflows. Proactive in surfacing risks and raising solutions early.

- Needs to thrive in a tool-driven environment where automation, reusability, and scale are essential.

- Strong communication required: must validate pipelines directly in game builds without hand-holding.

- Should be comfortable balancing quality with scalability across archetypes and legacy asset conversion

- Maintain artistic direction and quality across materials, shaders, and assets.

- Create final materials for characters, environments, and effects; support existing material systems.

- Develop efficient workflows and pipelines to support art and design teams.

- Research and implement new techniques to improve quality and performance of assets.

- Collaborate closely with Art, Animation, Design, and Engineering to resolve pipeline and asset issues.

- Propose tools and automation pipelines for iteration, optimization, and procedural workflows.

- Debug and profile assets to ensure performance across platforms.

- Provide technical feedback, documentation, and mentoring for other artists.

- Un portefeuille solide présentant des travaux de qualité AAA dans le domaine des moteurs (propriétaires, Unreal ou Unity).

job.description:
Join the VRChat Team!

 VRChat offers a first-of-its-kind, game-changing platform that provides an endless collection of social VR experiences and gives the power of creation to its robust community. With over 250,000 worlds and growing, VRChat ’s vision is to allow users to bring their imaginations to life and help shape the metaverse anywhere in the world on any device. VRChat has raised $100M to date with the support of investors, Makers Fund, Anthos Capital and HTC. 

 We have a great team which includes people from: Netflix, Twitter, Meta, Microsoft, Roblox, Google, Amazon, Unity, Spotify, Discord, Uber, eBay, Robinhood, Twitch, Zynga and TikTok. Come and join the mission!

 Job Overview

 We’re looking for a full-stack engineer to join our Trust and Safety Tech team. We hire engineers to solve real user problems, not implement specs. You will be instrumental in discovering, developing, and refining the internal and external functionality that ensure users can find belonging within a safe, engaging environment. Your work will help ensure VRChat scales safely, protecting growth and trust by reducing harm with low friction. This role involves working within Node.js/Mongo backend and React frontend to deliver low-friction, scalable moderation, anti-abuse, and safety systems.

 Who You Are

 A pragmatic, full-stack engineer who treats safety and privacy as first-class design constraints. Comfortable across the MERN stack, comfortable with adversarial thinking, and comfortable being on-call for systems that matter.

 What You'll Do

- Work within a full-stack team to develop, implement, and maintain new features for the VRChat platform and operational team. 

- Focus on enhancing safety systems, building the UI/UX and backend systems for support, moderation, and safety operations, with consideration for cost and user privacy. 

- Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers across the stack to translate product and design vision into functional code through informed tradeoffs and accurate estimates.

- Contribute to all stages of the feature lifecycle, from initial concept and prototyping to deployment and post-launch iteration and maintenance.

- Ensure the usability, stability, reliability, and performance of critical moderation and safety services, participating in on-call rotations as needed. 

- Participate in code reviews to maintain a high bar for code quality, architectural integrity, performance, and reliability while spreading knowledge across the team.

- Contribute to a culture embracing collaborative, iterative, outcome-focused, product-discovery-driven delivery.

 Qualifications

- Professional experience developing, building and maintaining web applications, preferably in social or gaming contexts. 

- Proficiency in the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) and related technologies like Redis.

- Experience building scalable, RESTful APIs. 

- Experience building usable, responsive web front ends using React and CSS, or other similar technologies.

- Experience with database design and optimization, state management, and third-party integrations.

- Familiarity with version control systems and CI/CD pipelines.

- Experience with operational excellence: observability, on-call, incident response, and reliability practices for production systems. 

- Comfort designing systems with adversarial users in mind: anticipating abuse vectors, false-positive costs, and graceful degradation. 

- Experience handling sensitive user data with appropriate privacy and access controls. 

- Comfort collaborating with non-engineering partners (operations, legal, policy) on product trade-offs. 

- An agile, collaborative, product mindset and excellent communication skills, capable of working effectively in a remote, cross-functional team environment.

- Demonstrated interest in online communities, VR, or VRChat (as a user or creator).

 Bonus Points

- Understanding of a game client/server architecture and data flow, especially as it relates to telemetry or abuse vectors.

- Experience with Unity/C# (for in-game safety UI surfaces like reporting flows). 

- Experience with ML-adjacent systems (model serving, evaluation, human-in-the-loop pipelines). 

- Experience working in, or directly with, moderation or Trust and Safety teams.

- Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, GCP) and containerization (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes.)

 Benefits

- Work from anywhere! VRChat is a 100% remote company offering flexible working hours in combination with core hours supporting real-time collaboration

- Health Benefits

- 401K for US & Group RRSP for Canadian Employees

- Stock Options

- Generous paid holiday schedule

- Unlimited/flexible vacation time

- Paid parental leave benefits

 VRChat is an equal-opportunity employer, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds. VRChat fosters a diverse, creative, and collaborative environment where anyone can contribute to any of the ongoing projects or direction of the roadmap at any time. If you’re a passionate team player who wants to have an impact on a dynamic team, we’d love to hear from you!

 All job offers are subject to satisfactory referencing and background checks.

 We are looking for a Lead Environmental Artist who combines a strong artistic eye with solid technical expertise. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.

 For more information, visit xsolla.com.

- Lead the creation of high-quality environments from concept through final implementation.

- Establish and maintain the visual quality bar for environments while ensuring technical and performance requirements are met.

- Create optimized environment assets, including modular kits, architecture, terrain, props, materials, and set dressing.

- Work closely with Technical Artists, Level Designers, Lighting Artists, and Engineers to balance visual quality with performance.

- Define and maintain environment art pipelines, workflows, and technical standards.

- Identify and resolve performance issues related to geometry, materials, textures, lighting, draw calls, memory usage, LODs, and asset complexity.

- Review and provide feedback on the work of Environment Artists and support their professional development.

- Collaborate with Art Direction to translate the artistic vision into scalable and technically achievable environments.

- Participate in profiling and optimization throughout production rather than treating optimization as a final-stage task.

 REQUIREMENTS

- Strong professional experience as a Senior or Lead Environment Artist in game development.

- Excellent portfolio demonstrating visually compelling, production-ready environments.

- Strong understanding of real-time optimization and the ability to make informed trade-offs between visual fidelity and performance.

- Advanced knowledge of environment production pipelines, modular workflows, LODs, materials, shaders, texture optimization, and asset budgets.

- Strong proficiency with industry-standard 3D tools and experience working in Unreal Engine and/or Unity .

- Good understanding of lighting, composition, scale, color, and environmental storytelling.

- Ability to profile environments, identify technical bottlenecks, and collaborate with technical teams to resolve them.

- Leadership and mentoring experience, with the ability to provide clear and constructive artistic and technical feedback.

- Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Role Overview
 This role is first and foremost about hands-on engineering, owning both the code that makes our games work and the technical decisions that keep them shippable. 
 We’re looking for a Senior Engineer to work on one of our successful franchises. This is a highly hands-on role, with more than ninety percent of your time spent directly in the build. In this role, you're responsible for defining the game's technical strategy and execution. You’ll contribute to and strengthen the ambition of our internally developed games, spanning prototyping to pipelines to long-term engine decisions, balancing velocity with stability, enabling fast iteration and clean, maintainable systems. You’ll work closely with a small, multidisciplinary team under the guidance of the studio’s Engineering Director. 
 Key Responsibilities
 1 - Engineering
 You're responsible for the engineering of our games and addons; taking a design vision and turning it into reality. You'll need to be a versatile, hands-on engineer with great gameplay and architectural sensibilities, moving from prototyping to rapid implementation and striking the right balance between code quality and speed.
 Success looks like:

- Rapid prototyping that validates ideas quickly and cheaply.

- Technical solutions that empower creativity and iteration.

- Close collaboration between design, art & code teams.

- Engineers are laser focused on things that deliver maximum value to players.

- Solid infrastructure in place (build servers, code repositories, etc).

- Clear data and playtesting feedback loops driving continuous improvement.

 2 - Technical Strategy and Execution
 Own the games’s technical roadmap from prototyping to production-ready pipelines. You will decide where to build, buy, outsource or adopt new technologies, always prioritising momentum and long-term leverage. 
 Success looks like:

- Reliable, performant codebases built for the now but with an eye on the future.

- A data pipeline leveraging tools, plugins, and new technologies as they develop.

- Stable builds that enable creative experimentation rather than blocking it.

- Establishing and maintaining technical infrastructure and workflows, such as source control and build pipelines, to enable the team to work efficiently and reliably.

 3 - Team Enablement
 You are the technical partner to design, art and production. You build the tools, workflows and shortcuts that let them work without waiting on you, and you give clear feasibility input early enough to shape decisions rather than veto them late.
 You translate technical constraints into terms the team can act on, and you take on the technical scoping when external help is needed, briefing contractors and reviewing what comes back so it lands cleanly in the build.
 Success looks like:

- Designers and artists iterating on content without engineering intervention.

- Tools and workflows that match how the team actually works day to day.

- Feasibility input shaping design decisions before they are committed.

- Technical constraints and trade-offs understood by the team early.

- External and contractor work that integrates cleanly into the codebase.

 Overall Measure of Success:

- The systems you own are performant, maintainable and shippable.

- Technical decisions you make early still hold up late in production.

- The team can produce and iterate on content without engineering bottlenecks.

- Engineering is an accelerator for the game rather than a constraint on it.

- New technologies are adopted and used to support rapid development and release.

 Requirements

- Proven experience as a Senior Engineer on shipped games

- Background in Unity, with deep understanding of scalable, systemic architectures.

- Expertise in rapid prototyping, optimisation, and live iteration workflows.

- Comfortable working on existing code bases, full game, DLC or port releases

- Pragmatic approach to technology, focusing on what moves the game forward.

- Interest in integrating new technologies and third-party assets to accelerate progress.

- Passion for strategy games and a drive to turn tech excellence into player delight.

 Please note: This is a remote-working position, open to anyone within the UK & Europe. 
 Benefits
 Our benefits include a 2-week company summer break and a 2-week winter break to rest and recharge, in addition to your normal holiday allowance.

- Experience with GameMaker Studio 2, Unreal Engine, Unity, or a similar game development platform. 

- Familiarity with GML (GameMaker Language), C#, and/or Python — the primary languages used across the codebase. 

- Good understanding of gameplay mechanics, game systems, debugging, and optimisation. 

- Experience taking game features from concept through development, testing, and refinement. 

- Ability to work with existing codebases, often built by other developers, and contribute to ongoing projects.

job.description:
Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.
 With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.
 This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.
 What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world's best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor.
 Since the start, we've raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who've built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.
 At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.
 Requirements
 As a Senior 3D Gameplay Artist (Animation & VFX) , you'll play a key role in owning the visual and motion game feel of our gameplay mechanics, from greybox to shipped asset, so that objects read as fun before a player ever touches them. You'll work directly with art direction, game design, and gameplay engineers on All in Hole, a top-50 grossing title, on the elements players interact with most. Your main responsibilities will include:
 
- 
 Own game feel end to end: take a mechanic from greybox and UX blockout through animation, VFX, and final sign-off

- 
 Animate gameplay objects by hand: idle, activation, interaction feedback, and state transitions, with real command of timing, weight, anticipation, and follow-through

- 
 Build VFX and shaders that land the hit: impact, feedback, and state change that communicate clearly without drowning the read of the object

- 
 Translate concept into 3D without losing its soul: match the intent, elevate the charm, and challenge the concept early when the gameplay asks for something different

- 
 Iterate directly in Unity: prefabs, colliders, animator state machines, and enough technical range to test your own ideas in minutes rather than hand them off

 This is a great opportunity to own the craft that players remember most, on a game already in the global top 50, with no one ahead of you in the queue — the person in this seat sets the bar for how gameplay objects look, move, and feel.
 Requirements
 We are looking for someone with around +5 years of experience building 3D core gameplay animations in mobile games, and the humility, curiosity, ambition, and drive to make an impact fast. You're a great fit if you have:

- 
 3D animation craft: hand-keyed work that gives personality and weight to objects that aren't characters, grounded in animation fundamentals rather than tooling

- 
 Strong VFX skills: particle systems and impact effects timed to reinforce readability, not decorate it

- 
 A core gameplay brain: you're a gamer, you read design intent off a prototype, and you can hold a real conversation with designers about why a mechanic is or isn't fun

- 
 Working fluency in Unity: blockouts, prefabs, animator and state machines, and the technical range to unblock yourself

- 
 Genuine shader ability: you can write and debug your own, not just wire up existing ones

- 
 Fidelity to concept: you hit the intent of a concept closely while making it better through the 3D pipeline

- 
 Clear visual communication: storyboards and blockouts that get every stakeholder seeing the same outcome before work starts

- 
 Autonomy and initiative : you hold a quality bar without it being checked for you, and you bring the unrequested improvement alongside the requested one

 Bonus points if you:

- Can concept the idea yourself and push it forward

- Have worked with physics-based gameplay

- Have mentored or reviewed other artists' work

 Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist. 
 Benefits
 Our Culture
 At Homa, we prioritize talent, energy, and determination over traditional credentials. We're building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, act with pragmatism, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values:

- 
 Humility: We recognise that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow — we stay grounded in a clear view of ourselves.

- 
 Curiosity: We continuously seek the "why" behind the "what" — we explore with purpose and practicality.

- 
 Focus: Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider — we obsess over the details and let pragmatism guide our attention.

- 
 Ambition: We strive for the best — we don't settle for "good enough" — we use common sense to reach higher.

 Benefits
 Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here's what you can expect:

- 🏥 Comprehensive Benefits: Depending on your location, you'll enjoy a range of perks such as insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym memberships, and more.

- 🏢 Paris HQ Access: Enjoy a desk at our private office in a well-located WeWork building that will give you access to WeWork perks like rooftop view and designed coworking spaces.

- 🌍 Coworking Access: You will have access to WeWork spaces throughout Europe, along with all their perks and professional office environments.

- 🌐 Global Team: Collaborate in English with top-tier talent from 35+ countries, spanning Europe, the UK, the US, and more. Diversity fuels our creativity and innovation.

- ✈️ Team Gatherings: We value time together beyond the screen. Join us for occasional team gatherings, off-site retreats (Workations as we name them) to connect, recharge, and celebrate.

- 📈 Performance Reviews: We're committed to your growth. Every six months, we reflect on your progress, recognize your achievements, and align on clear development goals.

- 💻 Equipment Support: From day one, we'll provide everything you need to do your best work, including a home office setup allowance if you're working remotely.

 Where We Hire
 Our HQ in Paris is a vibrant hub of creativity, collaboration, and connection. From rooftop lunches and coffee chats to after-work apéros and community events, we've designed a space people genuinely enjoy — all within a cosy WeWork filled with good energy (and snacks).
 We also have incredible team members across Europe — from Spain and Turkey to Germany, North Macedonia, Poland, the UK, and more. Whether you're working from a sunny WeWork in Barcelona or your home setup in Warsaw, you're fully part of our culture. To keep collaboration smooth, we primarily hire within European time zones (UTC to UTC+3). If you're based there — or planning to be — we'd love to hear from you!

job.description:
At PrizePicks , we are the fastest-growing sports company in North America, as recognized by Inc. 5000. As the leading platform for Daily Fantasy Sports, we cover a diverse range of sports leagues, including the NFL, NBA, and Esports titles like League of Legends and Counter-Strike. Our team of over 550 employees thrives in an inclusive culture that values individuals from diverse backgrounds, regardless of their level of sports fandom. Ready to reimagine the DFS industry together? 

 About the Role
 PrizePicks ’ Creative Collective is looking to add a Lead 3D Designer to our roster. The Creative Collective is a small, high-conviction team built around one standard: commit fully or not at all. We move fast, debate hard, and once a call is made, we stand behind it together.
 You'll lead our 3D discipline from start to finish, working alongside our Art Directors & Product teams to design a 3D language that adds to the fan experience in our product and throughout our marketing.

You are an elite 3D craftsperson first. You build characters, environments, and objects that add to the PrizePicks experience/brand, and you know when to hand-build and when to let AI tools do the heavy lifting so you can move faster without losing the idea. You're also the person who now decides how 3D work gets briefed, reviewed, and shipped across the organization.
 If you've spent your career being the best 3D mind in every room you've been in and you're ready to lead the discipline instead of just contributing to it, this is it.
 How We Work
 Lead with conviction — Be Iverson
 Bring work you believe in and have a strong POV. Authenticity matters more than the idea itself. If the idea could live with another brand's logo on it, it doesn't belong here. We'd rather refine a bold idea than try to save a safe one.
 ↳ Not: "This is just an option" or over-explaining to compensate for weak belief 
 Sharpen each other — Be Pharrell
 Value direct feedback and be comfortable in conflict. Debate makes the work better. Once a call is made, we move together. Mediocre work is a collective failure, not an individual one.
 ↳ Not: Silent agreement followed by side conversations or ego-driven critique 
 Execute under pressure — Be Jordan
 The standard does not change when the moment does. We move with precision and continually refine our judgment. Practice or clutch time, you show up with the same intensity.
 ↳ Not: "We didn't have time" or overcomplicating simple calls 
 Show up fully — Be Virgil
 Show up wherever you are needed, whenever you are needed, without hesitation. Not for credit — for the outcome. It's not about doing everything. It's about doing what's required to make it right.
 ↳ Not: "That's not my job" or trying to protect your role over protecting the work 
 What You'll Do
 Build worlds that feel unmistakably PrizePicks 

- Design and build 3D characters, environments, and objects for brand campaigns, product moments, and cultural activations

- Translate 2D concepts and mood boards into fully realized 3D executions

- Own the render quality bar — lighting, materials, composition — from first pass to final delivery

 Push what 3D + AI can do together

- Integrate AI image generation workflows (Weavy) into the 3D pipeline to speed up ideation and exploration

- Experiment with real-time rendering and emerging tools that shorten the distance between idea and finished asset

- Bring new techniques back to the team — you're the one testing what's next, not waiting for someone else to

 Lead the 3D discipline through craft, not authority 

- Own how 3D work gets briefed, reviewed, and delivered across the team

- Partner with the Art Directors so 3D work lands inside the bigger creative idea, not bolted onto it

- Create an environment where 3D work at PrizePicks is something the team is genuinely proud of

 Own the pipeline

- Maintain clean, reusable asset libraries, rigs, and templates so the team can move fast without rebuilding from scratch

- Balance multiple projects across brand, social, and campaign timelines without dropping quality

- Know when to hand-build and when to lean on procedural or AI-assisted workflows to hit a deadline without cutting corners

 Who You Are

- A maker first who's ready to lead — you'd rather build it than brief it out, and the team gets better because they watch you work

- Fast — what would take an agency weeks, you can do in days

- Deep in the tools — Blender/C4D (or equivalent) is second nature, not something you're still learning

- A player-coach — you lead through craft and feedback, not authority for its own sake

- Low ego about ownership

- Curious by default — new tools, new workflows, new techniques get you excited, not defensive

- Chronically online enough to know what culture actually looks/feels like right now

- Die hard sports fan

 Qualifications:

- 5+ years of 3D design experience, with a portfolio that shows range across character, environment, and object design

- Strong command of Blender (or equivalent: Cinema 4D, Maya) plus a rendering engine like Octane or Redshift

- Comfort integrating AI tools into a creative pipeline — this isn't optional, it's how we work now

- A sports, streetwear, or hip-hop culture fluency that shows up in your work, not just your playlist

 Bonus Points

- Experience with real-time engines (Unreal, Unity) or procedural tools (Houdini)

- Experience managing, mentoring, or directly leading other 3D or design talent

- Motion or animation background alongside 3D

 What Success Looks Like

- In 90 days, you’ll have a real working rhythm — the 3D work is faster and the output is sharper than it ever has been at PrizePicks .

- In six months, there's 3D work with your fingerprints on it that's genuinely moved the brand forward — campaigns, product moments, cultural activations that wouldn't have looked the same without you.

- In a year, the 3D discipline at PrizePicks is looked upon as the industry standard, and you're a big reason why.

 Location
 
- While we prefer candidates based in Atlanta, we are open to qualified applicants from anywhere in the U.S. and are willing to consider remote candidates. 
 Working at PrizePicks : 
 The typical salary range for this position is $90,000 to $110,000. At PrizePicks , we consider your role, level, and where you'll be working when determining our salary ranges. The compensation info you see on our job postings gives you an idea of the starting pay range for the position. Your actual pay within that range will depend on your specific work location, as well as your skills, experience, and education. Your recruiter will be happy to chat more about the specific pay range for your location and how we arrived at it during the hiring process. 
 This application period will remain open for 30 days. We’re committed to finding the best candidate, so this date may be adjusted, and any changes will be reflected in this posting.

 Benefits you’ll receive:

 In addition to your great compensation package, full-time employees will be eligible for the following perks: 

- Company-subsidized medical, dental, & vision plans 

- 401(k) plan with company match

- Flexible PTO to encourage a healthy work/life balance (2 weeks STRONGLY encouraged!)

job.description:
ABOUT YOU
 The Developer Evangelist – Integrations is a hands-on technical advocate who empowers game developers to successfully integrate Xsolla ’s products and features into their games. This role blends deep technical expertise, solution-building skills , and community presence to help developers create smooth, scalable, and high-quality implementations.
 We are looking for a specialist based in the APAC region . The ideal candidate combines technical proficiency with strong communication skills and is motivated to support developers in building successful integrations.
 You will work directly with partners, lead technical workshops, create integration-focused resources, and contribute to lighthouse cases—benchmark integrations that inspire both the industry and internal teams.
 ABOUT US
 
 Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.
 For more information, visit .
 RESPONSIBILITIES

- Lead hands-on developer sessions, integration walkthroughs, and partner workshops.

- Provide technical guidance for both custom integration scenarios and self-service implementations .

- Support partners in solving integration challenges quickly and effectively, acting as a trusted technical advisor.

- Develop high-quality technical resources, including: Integration guides, step-by-step tutorials, and sample code. Demo projects, reference implementations, and API usage examples. Recorded video walk throughs, technical webinars, and training sessions.

- Keep all resources up to date with the latest product features and integration best practices.

- Work with Product and Developer Relations leadership to deliver lighthouse integration cases —top-tier implementations that showcase the full potential of Xsolla ’s solutions.

- Document and package these integrations as reusable templates and inspiration for other developers.

- Represent Xsolla at industry events, technical conferences, and meetups.

- Conduct technical presentations, live demos, and coding sessions that inspire confidence in Xsolla ’s integration capabilities.

- Collect and relay developer feedback on integration processes and tools to Product and Engineering teams.

- Recommend improvements to SDKs, APIs, and documentation to streamline integration efforts.

- Track and report on: Number and quality of integrations delivered or supported. Engagement with integration-focused resources. Conversion rates from technical enablement to live integrations.

 QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

- 3–5 years in Developer Advocacy, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Evangelism, ideally in the game industry.

- Strong technical skills in game development and integration (e.g., Unity, Unreal, backend APIs, payment systems).

- Experience delivering hands-on technical training, demos, and workshops.

- Excellent problem-solving abilities and customer-focused mindset.

- Comfort in public speaking and presenting technical content to diverse audiences, English is a must.

- Ability to travel for partner visits, conferences, and training events

 Nice to Have:

- Fluent in either Korean or Japanese, with excellent written and spoken communication skills.

 The duties and responsibilities of this position may evolve over time to support the organization’s goals and individual growth.
